entries.source: Plans that delete or replace things, such as UI plans (hyper_ui_apply_plan) that delete or replace widgets, bindings or animations, and any other plan its tool marks destructive. The one-time permission the editor requires for each of these is issued without your click. Agent scripts are not part of this; they are under Scripts.

entries.source: Changes agents plan to assets and levels: Blueprints and Animation Blueprints, materials, animation, gameplay abilities, Niagara, PCG and scatter, landscape and mesh terrain, foliage, lighting, level blockout, arranging actors, sequences, World Partition, UI, modeling and placing models, retargeting, pose search, texture graphs and sound. Also playtests (they start Play In Editor and may record a video), movie renders written to disk, and Python scripts in which the runner's best-effort checks found nothing risky: they run inside one undo step behind a guard that is not a sandbox, and one may open another level when nothing is unsaved. Each change is saved to the project when it finishes; most can be taken back with Undo.
entries.text: 智能体对资产和关卡计划的更改：蓝图与动画蓝图、材质、动画、游戏性技能、Niagara、PCG 与散布、地形与网格地形、植被、光照、关卡白模、摆放 Actor、序列、World Partition、UI、建模与放置模型、重定向、姿势搜索、纹理图和声音。还包括试玩（会启动“在编辑器中运行”，并可能录制视频）、写入磁盘的影片渲染，以及运行器尽力检查后未发现风险的 Python 脚本：这些脚本在一个撤销步骤内运行，受一道并非沙盒的防护约束；没有未保存的内容时，脚本可能会打开另一个关卡。每项更改完成后都会保存到项目中；大多数可以通过“撤销”恢复。

entries.source: It is never saved. What it approved that has not started by then waits for your approval again.

entries.source: Requests that reach outside the editor: generating images (hyper_image_generate, with Codex, Gemini or a configured image service), generating 3D models (hyper_mesh_generate, with Tripo, Meshy or Hi3D), and submitting files to source control (hyper_source_control_submit, through Perforce, Git, Plastic or Lore, where your team receives them). Prompts and pictures are sent to those services. One image request may make up to 8 paid calls. Paid calls still stop at this session's spend cap of {0}, and auto-approval turns off if the cap or a service's or model's price changes while it is on; agent models use your agent plan.
entries.text: 会延伸到编辑器之外的请求：生成图片（hyper_image_generate，使用 Codex、Gemini 或已配置的图片服务）、生成 3D 模型（hyper_mesh_generate，使用 Tripo、Meshy 或 Hi3D），以及向源代码管理提交文件（hyper_source_control_submit，通过 Perforce、Git、Plastic 或 Lore，你的团队会收到这些文件）。提示词和图片会被发送到这些服务。一个图片请求最多可产生 8 次付费调用。付费调用仍受本次会话 {0} 的花费上限约束；开启期间如果上限或某项服务、模型的价格发生变化，自动批准会关闭。智能体模型会消耗你的智能体套餐。

entries.source: Sandbox Mode holds everything saved in the editor for review until you press Approve All in Activity: your own saves, and saves by tools that never asked for your approval, such as another MCP server's editor Python. With this ticked, auto-approval presses Approve All for you at a quiet moment, so those reach the project unreviewed. It waits until no asset has unsaved changes, Play In Editor is not running and no agent edit is running, and it never saves for you: an asset left unsaved, by you or by an agent's script, holds the write back until it is saved (Approve All saves what agents left unsaved first). A held removal deletes the project's own file, so removals are written only if Destructive tools is ticked too. Each write counts as one of its {0} approvals, and a failed write as one of its {1} failures in a row. Written files cannot be taken back with Undo.
entries.text: 沙盒模式会保留编辑器中保存的所有内容以供审阅，直到你在“活动”中按下“全部批准”：包括你自己的保存，以及从未请求你批准的工具所做的保存，例如另一个 MCP 服务器的编辑器 Python。勾选此项后，自动批准会在空闲时替你按下“全部批准”，因此这些内容会未经审阅就写入项目。它会等到没有资产有未保存的更改、“在编辑器中运行”未在运行，且没有智能体编辑正在运行，而且它从不替你保存：任何未保存的资产（无论是你还是智能体脚本留下的）都会推迟写入，直到它被保存（“全部批准”会先保存智能体留下的未保存内容）。保留的删除会删除项目自身的文件，因此只有同时勾选“破坏性工具”时才会写入删除。每次写入计为其 {0} 次批准中的一次，失败的写入计为其连续 {1} 次失败中的一次。写入的文件无法通过“撤销”恢复。

entries.source: Editor Python from hyper_script_run that the runner could not prove safe: it deletes, renames or merges assets or folders, destroys actors or components, imports files from disk, opens another level while this one has unsaved changes, runs console commands or more Python, writes files outside its own folder, closes the editor, or imports modules such as os, subprocess, socket, ctypes or requests. These scripts run without an undo step and without the guard, with your account's rights: they can delete or overwrite any of your files, start programs, use the network, and read keys kept in environment variables.
entries.text: 运行器无法证明安全的 hyper_script_run 编辑器 Python 脚本：它会删除、重命名或合并资产或文件夹，销毁 Actor 或组件，从磁盘导入文件，在当前关卡有未保存更改时打开另一个关卡，运行控制台命令或更多 Python，在自身文件夹之外写文件，关闭编辑器，或导入 os、subprocess、socket、ctypes、requests 等模块。这类脚本运行时没有撤销步骤，也没有防护，并拥有你账户的全部权限：它们可以删除或覆盖你的任何文件、启动程序、访问网络，以及读取保存在环境变量中的密钥。

entries.source: Your preferred agent builds the level toward the reference as a level designer would: a camera framed like it, the big shapes at real scale, then materials and light. HyperAI checks after every round and sends it back to work until it scores 72. Its level, lighting and material edits are approved for you while it runs.

entries.source: Your preferred agent relights the level until it scores 78 against the reference: sun, sky, fog, exposure and grade, or an Ultra Dynamic Sky's own settings, and how its surfaces take the light. HyperAI checks after every round and sends it back to work until it matches, and keeps a study of each job so the next one starts from it. Its lighting edits are approved for you while it runs, and stay unsaved until it matches.
entries.text: 你的首选智能体会为关卡重新布光，直到与参考图像的得分达到 78：太阳、天空、雾、曝光和调色，或 Ultra Dynamic Sky 自身的设置，以及各个表面如何承接光线。HyperAI 会在每一轮之后检查，并让它继续工作，直到匹配为止；它还会为每个任务保留一份研究记录，让下一个任务从中起步。它运行期间的光照修改会替你批准，并在匹配之前保持未保存。

把智能体的对话调到前面。

entries.source: Stop the agent's turn and stop sending it back to work. What it changed so far stays, unsaved.
entries.text: 停止智能体当前的回合，并不再让它继续工作。它到目前为止所做的修改会保留，但尚未保存。

entries.source: Name and type pairs; types are bool, int, float, name, string, vector or rotator.
entries.text: 名称与类型成对填写；类型可为 bool、int、float、name、string、vector 或 rotator。

entries.source: Dry-run and add typed keys for alert, search and patrol state to the selected Blackboard, then prove each key and type by inspection.
entries.text: 先试运行，再向所选黑板添加警戒、搜索和巡逻状态的类型化键，并通过检查逐一证明每个键及其类型。

entries.source: Add stealth-guard keys to a blackboard
entries.text: 为黑板添加潜行守卫所需的键

entries.source: Load every AI asset in a folder and report broken nodes, blackboard link mismatches, perception gaps and leftover breakpoints. Changes nothing.
entries.text: 加载文件夹中的所有 AI 资源，报告损坏的节点、黑板关联不一致、感知缺失和遗留断点。不做任何修改。

entries.source: Audit behaviour trees, blackboards and AI controllers
entries.text: 审计行为树、黑板和 AI 控制器

entries.source: Upper bound for each sense's max age, in seconds.
entries.text: 每种感知最大记忆时长的上限，单位为秒。
每个控制器必需的感知

entries.source: Read the senses, max ages and dominant sense of each AI controller and flag the ones that forget too slowly, never see, or fail to compile.
entries.text: 读取每个 AI 控制器的感知、最大记忆时长和主导感知，标出遗忘过慢、看不见目标或无法编译的控制器。

entries.source: Check AI perception settings on every controller
entries.text: 检查所有控制器的 AI 感知设置

entries.source: Create a Blueprint service that updates DistanceToTarget and bInAttackRange on a combat drone's Blackboard four times a second.
entries.text: 创建一个蓝图服务，每秒四次更新战斗无人机黑板上的 DistanceToTarget 和 bInAttackRange。

entries.source: Make a BT service that tracks range to the player
entries.text: 制作跟踪与玩家距离的行为树服务

entries.source: Create a Blueprint BT task that finds a random reachable point near a wolf and writes it to a vector key, adding the key if it is missing.
entries.text: 创建一个蓝图行为树任务：在狼附近找一个可到达的随机点并写入向量键；若该键缺失则一并添加。

entries.source: Make a behaviour tree task that picks a roam point
entries.text: 制作挑选漫游点的行为树任务

entries.source: Report which Behavior Tree, State Tree, EQS, Smart Object and Gameplay Behavior features HyperAI can inspect or edit here, and what to enable.
entries.text: 报告 HyperAI 在此项目中可检查或编辑的行为树、状态树、EQS、智能对象和 Gameplay Behavior 功能，以及需要启用的插件。

entries.source: Check which AI features this project can use
entries.text: 查看本项目可用的 AI 功能

entries.source: Diagnose an AI that never moves: its controller, tree and blackboard, the navmesh under it, and its speed and log in play, ranked by likely cause.
entries.text: 诊断一个从不移动的 AI：检查其控制器、行为树和黑板、脚下的导航网格，以及游戏中的速度和日志，按可能性排序原因。

entries.source: Find out why an enemy stands still in play
entries.text: 找出敌人在游戏中原地不动的原因

entries.source: Or one Blackboard object path for every tree.
entries.text: 也可填写一个黑板对象路径，供所有树使用。

entries.source: Find trees whose runtime and editor blackboards disagree or are missing, dry-run the relink, and confirm it once each tree is fixed.
entries.text: 找出运行时黑板与编辑器根节点黑板不一致或缺失的行为树，试运行重新关联，并在每棵树修复后加以确认。

entries.source: Fix behaviour trees that use the wrong blackboard
entries.text: 修复使用错误黑板的行为树

entries.source: Turn the selected Behavior Tree into an indented outline of composites, tasks, decorators and services, with its blackboard keys and any errors.
entries.text: 把所选行为树整理成带缩进的大纲，列出组合节点、任务、装饰器和服务，以及其黑板键和所有错误。

entries.source: Explain a behaviour tree as a readable outline
entries.text: 把行为树讲解成易读的大纲

entries.source: A Character Blueprint; made from Character in the AI folder if missing.
entries.text: 一个角色蓝图；若不存在，则在 AI 文件夹中基于 Character 创建。

entries.source: Make an AI controller Blueprint with sight perception that walks tagged patrol points and chases the player, then prove both in play.
entries.text: 创建带视觉感知的 AI 控制器蓝图，让其沿带标签的巡逻点行走并追击玩家，然后在游戏中证明这两种行为。

entries.source: Build a guard that patrols and chases on sight
entries.text: 构建会巡逻并在看见玩家时追击的守卫

entries.source: Verify in play that zombies close in and catch a player who stands still, measure whether they can be outrun, and record a run to review.
entries.text: 在游戏中验证僵尸会逼近并抓住站着不动的玩家，衡量能否甩开它们，并录制一段运行视频供审阅。

entries.source: Playtest that enemies notice, chase and catch you
entries.text: 试玩验证敌人会发现、追击并抓住你

entries.source: Rename a key on the selected Blackboard, repoint the tree nodes that read it, and prove every selector and asset still validates.
entries.text: 重命名所选黑板上的键，把读取该键的行为树节点改指新键，并证明每个键选择器和资源仍能通过验证。

entries.source: Rename a blackboard key and repoint its tree nodes
entries.text: 重命名黑板键并更新引用它的树节点

entries.source: Walk the selected State Tree's states, tasks and transitions and flag states with no way in, no way out or nothing to do.
entries.text: 遍历所选状态树的状态、任务和转换，标出无法进入、无法离开或什么都不做的状态。

entries.source: Review a State Tree for dead ends and empty states
entries.text: 审查状态树中的死胡同和空状态

entries.source: Blackboards under the content folder's AI subfolder.
entries.text: 位于内容文件夹 AI 子文件夹下的黑板。

entries.source: Give orc and goblin Blackboards one parent that holds their shared keys, remove the duplicates and prove every key still resolves.
entries.text: 让兽人和哥布林的黑板继承同一个保存共享键的父黑板，删除重复键，并证明每个键仍能解析。

entries.source: Share common keys through a parent blackboard
entries.text: 通过父黑板共享通用键

entries.source: Check the navmesh covers each tagged patrol point, then walk the route in play and report any leg where a pawn gets stuck.
entries.text: 检查导航网格是否覆盖每个带标签的巡逻点，然后在游戏中走一遍路线，报告 Pawn 卡住的每一段。

entries.source: Prove every patrol point is reachable on the navmesh
entries.text: 证明导航网格上每个巡逻点都可到达

entries.source: How far below the entering threshold the leaving one sits.
entries.text: 离开阈值比进入阈值低多少。

entries.source: Run the Animation Blueprint checks, then fix shared thresholds, zero or slow blends, frozen one-shot states and unset variables in one plan.
entries.text: 运行动画蓝图检查，再用一个计划修复共用阈值、零或过慢的混合、卡住的单次状态和未设置的变量。

entries.source: Fix flickering states and popping blends in an Anim BP
entries.text: 修复动画蓝图中的状态闪烁和混合跳变

entries.source: Build a hit-react montage with Light, Medium, Heavy and Back sections, and make sure the Blueprint's DefaultSlot and inertialization play it.
entries.text: 制作含轻、中、重和背后受击分段的受击蒙太奇，并确保动画蓝图的 DefaultSlot 和惯性化节点能播放它。

entries.source: Play hit reactions over everything with a full-body slot
entries.text: 用全身插槽让受击反应覆盖所有动画

entries.source: 1D on Speed, or 2D on Direction and Speed like the template's BS_Idle_Walk_Run.
entries.text: 以 Speed 为轴的一维混合空间，或像模板中 BS_Idle_Walk_Run 那样以 Direction 和 Speed 为轴的二维混合空间。

entries.source: A new Animation Blueprint for a skeleton: Speed driven every frame, Idle and Move states with a 10/5 hysteresis gap, compiled clean.
entries.text: 为骨架新建动画蓝图：每帧驱动 Speed，待机与移动状态之间有 10/5 的滞回间隔，编译无误。

entries.source: Create an idle-to-move locomotion Animation Blueprint
entries.text: 创建待机到移动的运动动画蓝图

entries.source: Machine: From to To, comma separated.
entries.text: 格式为“状态机: 源状态 to 目标状态”，用逗号分隔。

entries.source: Add an Inertialization node and switch the stop and landing transitions to inertialization, so large pose changes stop popping.
entries.text: 添加惯性化节点，把停步和落地过渡改为惯性化混合，消除大幅度姿势变化时的跳变。

entries.source: Smooth big pose changes with inertialization blends
entries.text: 用惯性化混合平滑大幅度姿势变化

entries.source: Drive IsFalling every frame and add Fall and a play-once Land state with the cookbook's rules and blends, then prove it in a jump.
entries.text: 每帧驱动 IsFalling，按手册的规则和混合添加下落状态和只播一次的落地状态，并在跳跃中验证。

entries.source: Add jump, fall and land states to an Anim Blueprint
entries.text: 为动画蓝图添加起跳、下落和落地状态

entries.source: A 1D Speed blend space on the same skeleton.
entries.text: 同一骨架上的一维 Speed 混合空间。

entries.source: Create an Animation Layer Interface, implement it in the main Blueprint with its current clips, play layers from states and add a rifle layer.
entries.text: 创建动画层接口，在主蓝图中以现有动画实现它，由状态播放各层，并添加一个步枪动画层蓝图。

entries.source: Set up linked anim layers for per-weapon locomotion
entries.text: 为按武器切换的移动动画设置链接动画层

entries.source: A 1D Speed blend space on the same skeleton.
entries.text: 同一骨架上的一维 Speed 混合空间。

entries.source: Create a layer Blueprint for one more weapon that implements the project's Animation Layer Interface and fills every layer, ready to link.
entries.text: 为又一把武器创建实现项目动画层接口的层蓝图，填满每一层，随时可以链接。

entries.source: Add a new weapon's anim layer Blueprint
entries.text: 为新武器添加动画层蓝图

entries.source: Run the character in play, capture starts, stops and landings on video, then retune any blend or threshold that pops or flickers.
entries.text: 在游戏中运行角色，录像并截取起步、停步和落地，再调整任何跳变或闪烁的混合时间与阈值。

entries.source: Playtest locomotion and tune its transition blends
entries.text: 试玩移动动画并调整过渡混合

entries.source: Find states nothing reaches or nothing leaves, then remove or reconnect them after a dry run, and re-check every machine.
entries.text: 找出无法到达或无法离开的状态，试运行后删除或重新连接，并复查每个状态机。

entries.source: Prune unreachable and dead-end states safely
entries.text: 安全清理不可达和无出口的状态

entries.source: Build a Speed blend space from a creature's gait clips at their real speeds, then an Animation Blueprint with idle and gait states.
entries.text: 用生物的步态动画按真实速度制作 Speed 混合空间，再创建含待机与步态状态的动画蓝图。

entries.source: Animate a quadruped creature's walk, trot and gallop
entries.text: 为四足生物制作行走、小跑和疾驰动画

entries.source: A looping sequence on the Blueprint's skeleton.
entries.text: 动画蓝图骨架上的循环序列。
以 Speed 为轴的一维混合空间。

entries.source: Drive IsCrouching, add crouch states with soft blends and rules that never compete, keeping the Speed hysteresis gap.
entries.text: 驱动 IsCrouching，添加柔和混合的蹲伏状态，规则互不冲突，并保留 Speed 的滞回间隔。

entries.source: Add crouch idle and crouch walk for a stealth character
entries.text: 为潜行角色添加蹲伏待机和蹲伏行走

entries.source: Machine.State = asset object path, separated by semicolons.
entries.text: 格式为“状态机.状态 = 资产对象路径”，用分号分隔。

entries.source: Point named states at new sequences or blend spaces, such as retargeted clips, without touching rules, then prove nothing else changed.
entries.text: 把指定状态换成新的序列或混合空间（例如重定向后的动画），不改动规则，并证明其他内容未变。

entries.source: Swap the clips an Animation Blueprint's states play
entries.text: 替换动画蓝图各状态播放的动画

entries.source: Optional; skipped when it does not exist.
Attack montage to move into the slot
entries.text: 要移入该插槽的攻击蒙太奇

entries.source: Add an UpperBody layered slot from spine_01, a full-body DefaultSlot and an Inertialization node, adding the skeleton slot if missing.
entries.text: 添加从 spine_01 开始的 UpperBody 分层插槽、全身 DefaultSlot 和惯性化节点，缺少骨架插槽时一并添加。

entries.source: Play attacks on the upper body while the legs keep running
entries.text: 让攻击只作用于上半身，同时双腿继续奔跑

entries.source: A simple NPC Animation Blueprint with an IsTalking flag gameplay sets, Idle and Talk states with soft blends, and an honest warning check.
entries.text: 简单的 NPC 动画蓝图：由玩法设置 IsTalking 标志，待机与对话状态柔和混合，并如实报告警告。

entries.source: Give a village NPC idle and talking states
entries.text: 为村庄 NPC 制作待机和对话状态

entries.source: Validate every montage, sequence, composite and blend space in a folder, then propose fixes as dry-run plans without changing anything.
entries.text: 校验文件夹中所有蒙太奇、序列、合成和混合空间，再以试运行计划给出修复方案，不做任何改动。

entries.source: Audit a folder of animations and dry-run the fixes
entries.text: 审查一个文件夹的动画并试运行修复

entries.source: For a skeleton no template knows: correct guessed chains and root, map by fuzzy names, enable the IK pass and re-retarget test clips.
entries.text: 针对模板无法识别的骨架：修正猜测的骨链和根骨骼，按模糊名称映射，开启 IK 处理，并重新重定向测试动画。

entries.source: Fix a custom skeleton's retarget chains and IK feet
entries.text: 修复自定义骨架的重定向骨链和 IK 脚部

entries.source: A Sound Wave or Sound Cue; sounds are skipped when it does not exist.
entries.text: 声波或声音提示；不存在时跳过音效。

entries.source: Where the left foot lands, as a fraction of the clip length (0-1).
entries.text: 左脚落地的位置，以动画长度的比例表示（0-1）。

entries.source: Where the right foot lands, as a fraction of the clip length (0-1).
entries.text: 右脚落地的位置，以动画长度的比例表示（0-1）。

entries.source: Mark left and right foot plants on looping cycles with sync markers and footstep sound notifies, one sequence per plan.
entries.text: 在循环动画上用同步标记标出左右脚落地点，并添加脚步声通知，每个序列一个计划。

entries.source: Add footstep sync markers and sounds to walk cycles
entries.text: 为循环步态添加脚步同步标记和音效

entries.source: How fast the run or jog clip actually travels; also the axis maximum.
entries.text: 奔跑或慢跑动画实际移动的速度，同时也是轴的最大值。

entries.source: How fast the walk clip actually travels.
entries.text: 行走动画实际移动的速度。

entries.source: Create a Speed blend space for a skeleton with idle, walk and run samples placed at the speeds the clips travel, so feet do not slide.
entries.text: 为骨架创建 Speed 混合空间，把待机、行走、奔跑样本放在各动画实际移动的速度上，避免滑步。

entries.source: Make a 1D idle-walk-run blend space at true speeds
entries.text: 按真实速度制作一维待机-行走-奔跑混合空间

entries.source: Create a Pose Search schema with Epic's default channels and a database of locomotion clips, build its index and report the pose count.
entries.text: 创建带 Epic 默认通道的 Pose Search 架构和移动动画数据库，构建索引并报告姿势数量。

entries.source: Build and index a motion matching locomotion database
entries.text: 构建并索引运动匹配移动数据库
每次小动作前的待机循环次数

entries.source: Build an animation composite that loops a base idle with idle-break clips between, so background NPCs stop looking robotic.
entries.text: 制作动画合成：基础待机循环之间穿插待机小动作，让背景 NPC 不再显得呆板。

entries.source: Chain idle breaks into a long NPC idle composite
entries.text: 把待机小动作串成 NPC 长待机合成动画

entries.source: Used for the folder, retargeter and clip prefix.
entries.text: 用于文件夹、重定向器和动画前缀。

entries.source: Make IK Rigs for both meshes and an auto-set-up retargeter, copy a folder of animations onto the target and check every chain maps.
entries.text: 为两个网格创建 IK Rig 和自动设置的重定向器，把整个文件夹的动画复制到目标角色，并检查每条骨链都已映射。

entries.source: Retarget a clip set onto a new character with IK Rigs
entries.text: 用 IK Rig 把一组动画重定向到新角色

entries.source: How fast the jog clips travel; the Speed axis maximum.
entries.text: 慢跑动画的移动速度，即 Speed 轴的最大值。

entries.source: A 2D Direction by Speed blend space with an idle row and eight jog directions, for a shooter character that strafes while aiming.
entries.text: 方向×速度的二维混合空间，含一排待机样本和八个慢跑方向，适合边瞄准边横移的射击角色。

entries.source: Build an 8-way strafe blend space for a rifle character
entries.text: 为步枪角色制作八方向横移混合空间

entries.source: Enable root motion on a dash clip and wrap it in a fast full-body montage with invulnerability start and end events.
entries.text: 为冲刺动画开启根运动，并包装成快速的全身蒙太奇，带无敌帧开始和结束事件。

entries.source: Turn a dash clip into a root-motion dodge montage
entries.text: 把冲刺动画做成根运动闪避蒙太奇

entries.source: Stop when more bones than this are missing from either skeleton.
entries.text: 任一骨架缺少的骨骼超过此数时停止。

entries.source: Mark two skeletons with matching bone names compatible both ways so clips, montages and blend spaces work on either.
entries.text: 把骨骼名称一致的两个骨架互相标记为兼容，使动画、蒙太奇和混合空间可在两者之间通用。

entries.source: Let two near-identical skeletons share animations
entries.text: 让两个几乎相同的骨架共享动画

entries.source: Your shotgun's reload clip; the default is the UE template's rifle reload as a stand-in.
entries.text: 你的霰弹枪换弹动画；默认值是 UE 模板中的步枪换弹动画，仅作替代。

entries.source: A reload montage with Start, Loop and End sections, a self-linked loop gameplay can exit, and a shell-inserted event per loop.
entries.text: 换弹蒙太奇含开始、循环、结束三个分段，循环段自链接且可由玩法跳出，每次循环触发一次装弹事件。

entries.source: Build a looping shell-by-shell shotgun reload montage
entries.text: 制作逐发装弹的循环霰弹枪换弹蒙太奇

entries.source: Add a float curve keyed to the cast's wind-up and release, so a material or Niagara parameter glows in sync with the animation.
entries.text: 添加一条按蓄力和释放打关键帧的浮点曲线，让材质或 Niagara 参数与动画同步发光。

entries.source: Key a hand-glow curve on a spell-cast animation
entries.text: 为施法动画添加手部发光曲线

entries.source: Folder holding the three attack clips, in play order by name.
entries.text: 存放三段攻击动画的文件夹，按名称排列即为播放顺序。

entries.source: An AnimNotifyState Blueprint class path ending in _C.
entries.text: 以 _C 结尾的 AnimNotifyState 蓝图类路径。

entries.source: One montage from three attack clips: a section per hit, hit-window notify states and branching combo windows, validated.
entries.text: 用三段攻击动画制作一个蒙太奇：每击一个分段，命中窗口通知状态和可分支的连招窗口，并完成校验。

entries.source: Build a three-hit sword combo montage with hit windows
entries.text: 制作带命中判定窗口的三连击剑术蒙太奇

entries.source: Rename sections to the project's convention, drop extra sections and a legacy notify track, dry-run first, then apply and re-check.
entries.text: 按项目约定重命名分段，删除多余分段和旧通知轨道，先试运行再应用并复查。

entries.source: Tidy a montage's sections and stale notifies
entries.text: 整理蒙太奇的分段和过时通知

entries.source: The engine default is -0.01; more negative keeps the current clip playing longer.
entries.text: 引擎默认值为 -0.01；越负越倾向于继续播放当前动画。

entries.source: Add a heading channel, stop looping idles reselecting, strengthen the continuing-pose bias, rebuild and confirm the pose count holds.
entries.text: 添加朝向通道，禁止循环待机动画重复选中，加强持续姿势偏置，重建后确认姿势数量不变。

entries.source: Tune a motion matching database for steadier picks
entries.text: 调优运动匹配数据库，让选帧更稳定

entries.source: a project folder of SoundWaves, or a folder of WAV files on disk
entries.text: 项目中的 SoundWave 文件夹，或磁盘上的 WAV 文件夹

entries.source: Beds, placed spot sounds, one shared convolution space and moving lanes, rendered as a crossfaded loop with a looping MetaSound.
entries.text: 铺底声、点缀音效、共享卷积空间和自动化运动，渲染为交叉淡化的无缝循环，并生成循环 MetaSound。

entries.source: Build a seamless ambience loop from library takes
entries.text: 用音效库素材制作无缝环境音循环

entries.source: Inspect and validate every SoundWave, Sound Cue and MetaSound under the folder: metrics, broken graphs and empty cues, without changing anything.
entries.text: 检查并验证文件夹下所有 SoundWave、Sound Cue 和 MetaSound：指标、损坏的图表和空的 Cue，不做任何修改。

entries.source: Audit the sound assets in a folder
entries.text: 审查文件夹中的音频资产

entries.source: a project folder of SoundWaves, or a folder of WAV files on disk
entries.text: 项目中的 SoundWave 文件夹，或磁盘上的 WAV 文件夹

entries.source: One set of performers across three roars: pitched vocal body with a sub, wet grit, glue and a grained tail in one space, measured per variant.
entries.text: 三段咆哮共用同一组表演素材：降调人声主体加低频、湿润颗粒、粘合层和颗粒化尾音，同一空间，逐个测量。

entries.source: Make three variants of a creature roar
entries.text: 制作三种生物咆哮变体

entries.source: Dry-run an attenuation and a concurrency asset plan for footsteps, report the checked values and effects, and submit only if the build can apply it.
entries.text: 对脚步声的衰减和并发资产方案进行试运行检查，报告核验后的数值与影响，仅在当前版本支持时才提交执行。

entries.source: Check a footstep attenuation and concurrency plan
entries.text: 检查脚步声衰减与并发方案

entries.source: Measure each session as it stands, re-render all to one peak with MetaSounds, and flag the ones whose average level still stands out.
entries.text: 先测量每个会话的现状，再统一峰值重新渲染并生成 MetaSound，标出平均电平仍明显偏离的音效。

entries.source: Level-match a set of Decibel sounds to one peak
entries.text: 将一组 Decibel 音效统一到相同峰值

entries.source: a project folder of SoundWaves, or a folder of WAV files on disk
entries.text: 项目中的 SoundWave 文件夹，或磁盘上的 WAV 文件夹

entries.source: Anticipation, a frame-zero snap, meat, sub-thud and material layer, a debris tail and one space, measured window by window, then rendered.
entries.text: 包含预备、零帧脆响、肉感、低频重击和材质层、碎屑尾音及统一空间，逐段测量后渲染成品。

entries.source: Design a layered melee impact with an AAA stack
entries.text: 按 3A 分层法设计近战打击声

entries.source: Whole bars of melody, chords, pad, bass and light percussion in one hall, phrased with lanes and rendered as a seamless music loop.
entries.text: 以整小节编写旋律、和弦、铺底、低音和轻打击乐，置于同一大厅空间，用自动化塑造乐句，渲染为无缝音乐循环。

entries.source: Compose a looping menu music track
entries.text: 创作可循环的菜单背景音乐

entries.source: A rising bell arpeggio, a warm pad and a sub on the final chord, humanized, in one hall, rendered as a one-shot with a MetaSound.
entries.text: 上行的钟声琶音、温暖铺底和终和弦低音，经人性化处理，置于同一大厅空间，渲染为单次播放的 MetaSound。

entries.source: Compose a quest-complete stinger in a hall
entries.text: 在大厅混响中创作任务完成提示乐句

entries.source: A breathy synth whoosh whose filter opens and closes, a clunk at the end and a small room, rendered with a MetaSound and measured.
entries.text: 合成气声般的呼啸，滤波器先开后合，结尾加机械撞击声和小房间混响，渲染为 MetaSound 并测量。

entries.source: Design a sci-fi door whoosh with a filter sweep
entries.text: 设计带滤波扫频的科幻开门呼啸声

entries.source: Three short synth UI sounds from one Decibel session, each rendered to its own SoundWave and MetaSound at one peak, measured and validated.
entries.text: 用一个 Decibel 会话合成三个简短的 UI 音效，分别渲染为 SoundWave 和 MetaSound，统一峰值并测量验证。

entries.source: Make a set of UI sounds: click, hover and confirm
entries.text: 制作一组 UI 音效：点击、悬停和确认

entries.source: A read-only review of a folder's Blueprints for heavy Tick graphs, Delays used as state, unchecked casts and per-frame searches, with fixes to do first.
entries.text: 只读检查文件夹中的蓝图：繁重的 Tick 图、充当状态的 Delay、未处理失败分支的类型转换和逐帧查找，并给出优先修复项。

entries.source: Audit Blueprints for Tick-heavy and fragile logic
entries.text: 审查蓝图中繁重的 Tick 和脆弱逻辑

entries.source: Checkpoint triggers record the furthest one reached in the Game Mode, and a kill volume sends the player back to it. Proven by a bot run.
entries.text: 检查点触发器在游戏模式中记录到达的最远检查点，死亡区域把玩家送回那里；由机器人跑一遍来验证。

entries.source: Add checkpoints that respawn the player after a fall
entries.text: 添加检查点，坠落后让玩家重生
单个事件拆分前的最大节点数

entries.source: Fold repeated or long node groups of the selected Blueprint into named functions, lay them out, and prove behaviour and compile state are unchanged.
entries.text: 把所选蓝图中重复或过长的节点组折叠为命名函数并重新排版，证明行为和编译状态不变。

entries.source: Refactor a sprawling event graph into functions
entries.text: 把杂乱的事件图重构为函数

entries.source: A quest-state enum and progress struct, a tracker that counts tagged pickups, completes at the target and opens a portal, proven by a bot Collect run.
entries.text: 任务状态枚举和进度结构体，加上统计带标签拾取物的追踪器：达到目标时完成并打开传送门，由机器人收集来验证。

entries.source: Track a collect quest with an enum state and a portal
entries.text: 用枚举状态和传送门追踪收集任务

entries.source: A spawner Blueprint that spawns drones on a timer at random points around it until a cap is alive, with counts checked in PIE.
entries.text: 生成器蓝图按定时器在周围随机位置生成无人机，直到存活数达到上限；在 PIE 中检查数量。

entries.source: Build a timed drone spawner with a live cap
entries.text: 制作有存活上限的定时无人机生成器

entries.source: Barrels that explode with radial damage after a short fuse, set off nearby barrels and break crates that drop loot, proven in PIE.
entries.text: 油桶在短暂引信后造成范围伤害，引爆附近油桶并炸碎会掉落战利品的箱子，在 PIE 中验证。

entries.source: Make explosive barrels that chain-react and break crates
entries.text: 制作会连锁爆炸并炸碎箱子的油桶

entries.source: Read the selected Blueprint's compiler messages, fix only the nodes they name, and prove it compiles clean with a before-and-after diff.
entries.text: 读取所选蓝图的编译器消息，只修复其中指出的节点，并用前后差异证明它能干净编译。

entries.source: Fix the compile errors in a broken Blueprint
entries.text: 修复损坏蓝图的编译错误

entries.source: Insert a Branch into the selected Blueprint's event chain with a checked node patch, so its logic runs only while a flag is true.
entries.text: 通过经过检查的节点补丁，在所选蓝图的事件链中插入 Branch，使其逻辑仅在开关为真时运行。

entries.source: Gate an existing event behind a bool with a Branch
entries.text: 用 Branch 让现有事件受布尔开关控制

entries.source: A Widget Blueprint progress bar bound to a health component's OnHealthChanged dispatcher, shown on screen and checked with UI asserts in PIE.
entries.text: Widget 蓝图进度条绑定生命值组件的 OnHealthChanged 事件分发器，显示在屏幕上，并在 PIE 中用 UI 断言检查。

entries.source: Hook a HUD health bar to the player's health
entries.text: 把 HUD 血条接到玩家生命值上

entries.source: An Actor Component with Health, MaxHealth, heal and death dispatchers, added to the player and proven against a hazard volume in PIE.
entries.text: 带 Health、MaxHealth、治疗和死亡事件分发器的 Actor 组件，加到玩家身上，并在 PIE 中用伤害区域验证。

entries.source: Add a reusable health component with damage events
entries.text: 添加带伤害事件的可复用生命值组件

entries.source: A Blueprint Interface with Interact, implemented by a lever and a chest and called from the player's interact input, proven by the bot.
entries.text: 带 Interact 函数的蓝图接口，由拉杆和宝箱实现，并由玩家的交互输入调用，由机器人验证。

entries.source: Wire an interact interface for levers and chests
entries.text: 为拉杆和宝箱接入交互接口

entries.source: An item struct and type enum, an inventory component with add, remove and count, and pickups that feed it, verified by a bot collecting them.
entries.text: 物品结构体与类型枚举、支持添加/移除/计数的背包组件，以及向背包添加物品的拾取物，由机器人收集来验证。

entries.source: Build an inventory with item structs and pickups
entries.text: 用物品结构体和拾取物搭建背包系统

entries.source: A launch pad Blueprint that fires Launch Character up and forward on overlap with a short cooldown, with the launch speed measured by the bot.
entries.text: 跳板蓝图在重叠时调用 Launch Character 向上向前弹射，带短冷却，由机器人测量弹射速度。

entries.source: Build a jump pad that launches the player
entries.text: 制作把玩家弹射出去的跳板

entries.source: A platform Blueprint that travels between two points on a looping vector timeline, checked in PIE at both ends of its path.
entries.text: 平台蓝图沿循环的向量时间轴在两点之间往返，在 PIE 中检查其到达路径两端。

entries.source: Make a looping moving platform the player can ride
entries.text: 制作玩家可乘坐的循环移动平台

entries.source: A server-authoritative door with a rep-notify Open flag and a multicast cue, checked on host, client and a late joiner in one playtest.
entries.text: 由服务器权威控制的门：Open 变量使用 RepNotify 并带多播提示，在同一次试玩中检查主机、客户端和中途加入者。

entries.source: Make a door replicate in a listen-server session
entries.text: 让门在监听服务器会话中同步

entries.source: Change literal pin values such as delays, speeds and damage in the selected Blueprint through one checked patch, then diff and compile it.
entries.text: 通过一次经过检查的补丁修改所选蓝图中的引脚字面值（延迟、速度、伤害等），然后比较差异并编译。

entries.source: Retune the numbers inside a Blueprint graph
entries.text: 调整蓝图图表中的数值

entries.source: A placed timer that counts down once per second without Tick, fires an OnTimeUp dispatcher at zero and stops, verified against the clock in PIE.
entries.text: 放置在关卡中的计时器，不用 Tick 每秒倒数一次，归零时触发 OnTimeUp 并停止；在 PIE 中对照时间验证。

entries.source: Add a round countdown timer with a time-up event
entries.text: 添加带时间到事件的回合倒计时

entries.source: A rune key pickup that tags the player and a sealed gate that lifts on a timeline only for a key holder, verified with and without the key.
entries.text: 符文钥匙拾取后给玩家加标签，封印之门只为持钥者沿时间轴升起；分别在有钥匙和无钥匙时验证。

entries.source: Lock a sealed gate behind a rune key pickup
entries.text: 用符文钥匙拾取物锁住封印之门

entries.source: Floor tiles that must be stepped on in the right order to raise a gate, with a wrong tile resetting it. Proven by right- and wrong-order bot runs.
entries.text: 地砖必须按正确顺序踩下才能升起大门，踩错则重置；由机器人分别按正确和错误顺序来验证。

entries.source: Build a rune-tile sequence puzzle that opens a gate
entries.text: 制作按顺序踩符文砖开门的谜题

entries.source: A SaveGame Blueprint plus save and load functions that keep the score across play sessions, proven by two separate playtests.
entries.text: SaveGame 蓝图加上保存与读取函数，让分数跨游戏会话保留，并用两次独立的试玩来验证。

entries.source: Save and load player progress with a SaveGame slot
entries.text: 用存档槽保存和读取玩家进度

entries.source: A pickup Blueprint that spins, adds points to the Game Mode's score when a pawn touches it and disappears, proven by a bot walking into it.
entries.text: 制作一个会旋转的拾取物蓝图：Pawn 碰到时为游戏模式的分数加分并消失，由机器人走过去拾取来验证。

entries.source: Build a spinning score pickup that adds points
entries.text: 制作一个旋转的加分拾取物

entries.source: Sweeping cameras with a vision cone that spot a player in line of sight, raise a level-wide alarm and turn the alarm lights red.
entries.text: 带视锥的摄像头来回扫视，发现视线内的玩家时触发全关卡警报，并把警报灯变红。

entries.source: Build security cameras that raise a stealth alarm
entries.text: 制作触发潜行警报的监控摄像头

entries.source: A turret Blueprint that turns toward a visible player in range and fires damaging bolts on a timer, verified by shots fired in and out of range.
entries.text: 炮塔蓝图转向射程内可见的玩家并按定时器发射伤害弹体，通过射程内外的开火次数来验证。

entries.source: Build a sentry turret that tracks and fires at the player
entries.text: 制作追踪并射击玩家的哨戒炮塔

entries.source: Hold-to-sprint on the player that drains stamina, stops sprinting at zero and regenerates after a pause, measured by the bot holding the input.
entries.text: 玩家按住冲刺会消耗耐力，耐力耗尽时停止冲刺，停顿后恢复；由机器人按住输入来测量。

entries.source: Add sprint with a draining, regenerating stamina
entries.text: 添加会消耗并恢复耐力的冲刺

entries.source: Find nodes piled on one spot in the selected Blueprint, repair them safely, lay the graph out on a grid and confirm no logic changed.
entries.text: 找出所选蓝图中堆在一起的节点，安全修复后按网格重新排版，并确认逻辑没有变化。

entries.source: Untangle stacked nodes in a messy Blueprint graph
entries.text: 理顺杂乱蓝图图表中堆叠的节点

entries.source: A door Blueprint whose hinge eases open over a timeline when a pawn enters its trigger and closes again on exit, checked in a recorded playtest.
entries.text: 门蓝图：Pawn 进入触发器时铰链沿时间轴平滑打开，离开时关闭，并用录像的试玩来检查。

entries.source: Make a door swing open on a timeline when approached
entries.text: 制作靠近时沿时间轴旋转打开的门

entries.source: A target Blueprint with clamped Health that hides and disables collision at zero, then respawns after a delay, tested by a spike trap.
entries.text: 目标蓝图：生命值有上下限，归零时隐藏并关闭碰撞，延时后重生；用尖刺陷阱进行测试。

entries.source: Build a training dummy that dies and respawns
entries.text: 制作会死亡并重生的训练假人
搜索、记忆与源代码管理

entries.source: Place the selected shot sequences back to back in a new master with fades, check timing and structure, and draft-render the whole.
entries.text: 把所选镜头序列首尾相接放入新的主序列并加淡入淡出，检查时序与结构，并渲染整体草稿。

entries.source: Assemble shot sequences into a master sequence
entries.text: 将镜头序列组装成主序列

entries.source: Five shots that diminish the hero and empower the boss: high and low angles, an extreme close, a crane, a dolly zoom and a hand-held two-shot.
entries.text: 五个镜头压低英雄、抬高 Boss：俯拍与仰拍、大特写、升降镜头、推拉变焦和手持双人镜头。

entries.source: Cut a boss reveal with low angles and a dolly zoom
entries.text: 剪辑带仰拍和推拉变焦的 Boss 登场

entries.source: Two cars keyed along a straight run, a tracking camera and a bumper camera keyed with them, and frames proving the cars stay in shot.
entries.text: 为两辆车沿直线打关键帧，手动放置侧面跟拍相机和车尾相机并随车打关键帧，用画面证明两车始终在镜头内。

entries.source: Stage a car chase with a keyed tracking camera
entries.text: 用关键帧跟拍相机布置飞车追逐

entries.source: A fast PNG draft of the selected sequence, a frame per cut checked for framing and holds, and the cut's review notes, with nothing changed.
entries.text: 为所选序列快速渲染 PNG 草稿，逐个剪辑点检查构图与时长，并列出剪辑审查意见，不做任何修改。

entries.source: Render a quick draft of a cutscene and review the cut
entries.text: 快速渲染过场草稿并审查剪辑

entries.source: Fade in and out, music from the first frame and a keyed light intensity falling to dusk on the selected sequence, leaving its shots unchanged.
entries.text: 为所选序列加入淡入淡出、从第一帧开始的音乐，以及逐渐降至黄昏的灯光强度关键帧，镜头保持不变。

entries.source: Add fades, music and a dusk lighting cue to a cutscene
entries.text: 为过场添加淡入淡出、音乐和黄昏灯光变化

entries.source: push_in, pull_out, crane_down, crane_up, orbit_left, orbit_right, truck_left...
An extreme wide camera move onto the selected landmark, a closer second angle and fades in and out, reviewed and draft-rendered.
entries.text: 对所选地标进行大远景运镜，再接一个更近的机位，加入淡入淡出，审查后渲染草稿。

entries.source: Open a level with an establishing reveal shot
entries.text: 用定场镜头为关卡开场

entries.source: local (in this editor, up to ten minutes) or remote (a new process from the saved level)
entries.text: local（在本编辑器中，最长十分钟）或 remote（从已保存关卡启动新进程）

entries.source: Make a final-quality EXR config, prove the sequence and config render-ready with a dry-run preflight, then render and count the frames.
entries.text: 创建最终质量的 EXR 配置，用试运行预检证明序列与配置可渲染，然后渲染并核对帧数。

entries.source: Render a final EXR master with a render-ready preflight
entries.text: 经渲染就绪预检后输出最终 EXR 母版

entries.source: Read the film editor's review of the selected sequence and fix each jump cut, crossed line, gap and buried camera, keeping its length.
entries.text: 读取所选序列的剪辑审查意见，逐个修复跳切、越轴、无镜头空档和埋进几何体的相机，保持总时长不变。

entries.source: Fix jump cuts and line crossings in a cutscene
entries.text: 修复过场中的跳切和越轴问题

entries.source: Transform keys on the selected gate or door, its sound on the timeline and a holding wide shot, checked by inspect and first and last frames.
entries.text: 为所选大门或门打变换关键帧，在时间轴上加入音效和固定远景，用检查结果及首尾帧验证。

entries.source: Key a gate swinging open with its sound in a cutscene
entries.text: 在过场中为大门开启打关键帧并配音效

entries.source: Copy Epic's default render graph, tune its output frame rate by the node names inspect reports, render the selected sequence and count frames.
entries.text: 复制 Epic 默认渲染图，按检查结果中的节点名设置输出帧率，渲染所选序列并核对帧数。

entries.source: Set up a Movie Render Graph and render with it
entries.text: 配置 Movie Render Graph 并用它渲染

entries.source: A placed cine camera at 85 mm f/1.8 whose manual focus distance is keyed from one actor to another, verified by keys and draft frames.
entries.text: 放置 85mm、f/1.8 的电影相机，为手动对焦距离打关键帧，让焦点从一个角色移到另一个，并用关键帧和草稿帧验证。

entries.source: Key a rack focus from a foreground to a background subject
entries.text: 为从前景到背景的移焦打关键帧

entries.source: A level sequence covering two selected characters the classic way: establishing two-shot, over-the-shoulders, a close-up, a reviewed cut and a draft render.
entries.text: 为两个所选角色按经典方式拍摄关卡序列：定场双人镜头、过肩镜头和特写，审查剪辑并渲染草稿。

entries.source: Shoot a two-person dialogue with shot and reverse shot
entries.text: 用正反打镜头拍摄双人对话

entries.source: An orbit and a detail push-in at 2.39:1 on the selected actor, a final-quality MP4 config checked render-ready, and the rendered file.
entries.text: 以 2.39:1 宽银幕对所选 Actor 做环绕和细节推镜，创建经渲染就绪检查的最终质量 MP4 配置，并输出成片。

entries.source: Make a letterboxed turntable of a vehicle and render MP4
entries.text: 为载具制作宽银幕环绕展示并渲染 MP4

entries.source: Two characters keyed walking onto their marks under a hand-keyed leading two-shot, then singles at the marks on one side of the line.
entries.text: 为两名并排走到站位的角色打关键帧，用随行关键帧相机拍领跑双人镜头，再在站位处拍不越轴的单人镜头。

entries.source: Stage a walk-and-talk with following shots
entries.text: 布置边走边谈的跟随镜头

entries.source: Leave empty for engine modules that are not in a plugin
entries.text: 不属于插件的引擎模块请留空

entries.source: Add an engine module to a game module's Build.cs, enable its plugin if needed, rebuild, and prove the module and plugin load cleanly.
entries.text: 在游戏模块的 Build.cs 中添加引擎模块，必要时启用其插件，重新构建，并证明模块和插件正常加载。

entries.source: Add a module dependency and rebuild the project
entries.text: 添加模块依赖并重新构建项目

entries.source: Mark a C++ function BlueprintCallable with a tooltip, rebuild, call it from a test Blueprint, and prove the result in PIE.
entries.text: 把 C++ 函数标记为 BlueprintCallable 并加提示，重新构建，从测试蓝图调用它，并在 PIE 中证明结果。

entries.source: Expose a C++ function to Blueprints and call it
entries.text: 把 C++ 函数暴露给蓝图并调用

entries.source: Relative to the project; a crash recovery build logs under Saved/HyperAIStudio/Recovery
entries.text: 相对于项目目录；崩溃恢复时的构建日志位于 Saved/HyperAIStudio/Recovery

entries.source: Read the build log the restart left, fix only the lines the compiler names, rebuild, and report each error as fixed or still open.
entries.text: 读取重启留下的构建日志，只修复编译器指出的行，重新构建，并逐条报告错误已修复或仍未解决。

entries.source: Fix the C++ errors from the last failed build
entries.text: 修复上次构建失败的 C++ 错误

entries.source: A RunTestsByFilter expression that also covers the tests next to it
entries.text: 一个同时覆盖其相邻测试的 RunTestsByFilter 表达式

entries.source: Run a failing test, trace its assertion to the code, fix the cause, rebuild, and prove it and the tests around it now pass.
entries.text: 运行失败的测试，从断言追溯到代码，修复根因后重新构建，并证明它和相关测试现在都已通过。

entries.source: Make a failing automation test pass again
entries.text: 让失败的自动化测试重新通过

entries.source: Check the trace setup, record CPU and frame events across a bot playtest with a bookmark, and report the .utrace file to open in Insights.
entries.text: 检查追踪设置，在机器人试玩期间录制 CPU 和帧事件并加书签，然后报告可在 Insights 中打开的 .utrace 文件。

entries.source: Record an Unreal Insights trace of a playtest
entries.text: 录制试玩过程的 Unreal Insights 追踪

entries.source: Edit a function body in the project's C++, compile it with Live Coding in the running editor, and prove the new behaviour in PIE against a baseline.
entries.text: 修改项目 C++ 中的函数体，在运行中的编辑器里用 Live Coding 编译，并在 PIE 中对照修改前的基线证明新行为。

entries.source: Change C++ logic and hot-reload it with Live Coding
entries.text: 修改 C++ 逻辑并用 Live Coding 热重载

entries.source: A number the bot can Sample: Speed, or a float variable of the Blueprint
entries.text: 机器人可采样的数值：Speed，或蓝图的浮点变量

entries.source: Port the selected Blueprint's Tick logic into a native parent class, reparent it, rebuild, and prove behaviour matches with before-and-after samples.
entries.text: 把所选蓝图的 Tick 逻辑移植到原生父类，重设父类并重新构建，用前后采样证明行为一致。

entries.source: Move a Blueprint's hot Tick logic into a C++ base class
entries.text: 把蓝图中耗时的 Tick 逻辑移到 C++ 基类

entries.source: A game module folder under Source/
entries.text: Source/ 下的游戏模块文件夹

entries.source: Write a C++ actor with designer-tunable properties, rebuild through an editor restart, then place it and prove its defaults and behaviour in PIE.
entries.text: 编写带可调属性的 C++ Actor，通过重启编辑器重新构建，然后放入关卡并在 PIE 中验证默认值和行为。

entries.source: Add a new C++ actor class and rebuild the editor
entries.text: 新增 C++ Actor 类并重新构建编辑器

entries.source: Audit dirty packages, Blueprint health, plugins and the build setup, preview the restart's saves and build, and restart only on your go-ahead.
entries.text: 审查未保存的包、蓝图健康状况、插件和构建配置，预览重启将保存和构建的内容，经你同意后才重启。

entries.source: Check the editor is safe to rebuild before a restart
entries.text: 重启前检查编辑器是否可以安全重新构建

entries.source: Python uses its snake_case name, such as cast_shadow
entries.text: Python 中使用蛇形命名，例如 cast_shadow

entries.source: One undoable editor script sets a component property on every selected actor; a scene check proves each value changed and nothing else did.
entries.text: 一个可撤销的编辑器脚本为每个所选 Actor 的组件设置属性；场景检查证明每个值都已修改且其他内容未变。

entries.source: Bulk-edit a property on selected actors in one undo step
entries.text: 在一个撤销步骤中批量修改所选 Actor 的属性

entries.source: Preview, then run one editor script that adds the right prefixes to assets in a folder, and prove the references followed the rename.
entries.text: 先预览，再运行一个编辑器脚本，为文件夹中的资产加上正确的前缀，并证明引用随重命名一起更新。

entries.source: Batch-rename assets to naming conventions with Python
entries.text: 用 Python 批量重命名资产以符合命名规范

entries.source: One read-only editor Python script lists textures above a resolution budget in a folder, with size, LOD group and compression, as a table.
entries.text: 一个只读的编辑器 Python 脚本列出文件夹中超出分辨率预算的纹理，包含尺寸、LOD 组和压缩设置，以表格呈现。

entries.source: List textures over a size budget with a read-only script
entries.text: 用只读脚本列出超出尺寸预算的纹理

entries.source: Rename a native class with a Core Redirect so every Blueprint child and placed actor follows it, then rebuild and prove they all load and compile.
entries.text: 用 Core Redirect 重命名原生类，让所有蓝图子类和已放置的 Actor 跟随更新，然后重新构建并证明它们都能加载和编译。

entries.source: Rename a C++ class without breaking its Blueprints
entries.text: 重命名 C++ 类而不破坏其蓝图

entries.source: Group the session's errors and warnings by category and pattern, trace each to the asset behind it, and list the fixes worth doing first.
entries.text: 按类别和模式归并本次会话的错误与警告，追溯每组背后的资产，并列出最值得优先处理的修复。

entries.source: Triage the editor log's errors and warnings
entries.text: 排查编辑器日志中的错误和警告

entries.source: Add a simple automation test that pins down a function's behaviour case by case, build it, run it, and show it passing under its exact name.
entries.text: 添加一个简单的自动化测试逐条锁定函数行为，构建、运行，并在其准确的测试名下展示通过。

entries.source: Write a C++ automation test for a gameplay function
entries.text: 为玩法函数编写 C++ 自动化测试

entries.source: Read the selected DataTables' rows and values, flag empty, zero and duplicate-looking entries, and prove the snapshot complete. Read-only.
entries.text: 读取所选数据表的行和值，标出空值、零值和疑似重复的条目，并证明快照完整。只读。

entries.source: Audit DataTables for missing and suspicious rows
entries.text: 审查数据表中缺失和可疑的行

entries.source: List the project's gameplay tags with their referencers, flag unused tags, near-duplicates and naming breaks, and suggest removals for approval.
entries.text: 列出项目的 Gameplay 标签及其引用者，标出未使用的标签、近似重复和命名问题，并给出待批准的删除建议。

entries.source: Audit gameplay tags for unused and misspelled entries
entries.text: 审查未使用和拼写有误的 Gameplay 标签

entries.source: Change the editor startup map, game default map and global game mode through Epic's config tools, prove the saved values and check the mode in play.
entries.text: 通过 Epic 的配置工具修改编辑器启动地图、游戏默认地图和全局游戏模式，验证保存后的值，并在试玩中检查游戏模式。

entries.source: Set the project's default maps and game mode
entries.text: 设置项目的默认地图和游戏模式

entries.source: Preview the enum change with HyperAI's data plan, append the new values, then compile every Blueprint that uses the enum and list switches to wire.
entries.text: 先用 HyperAI 数据计划预览枚举修改，再追加新值，然后编译所有使用该枚举的蓝图，并列出需要连线的 Switch 节点。

entries.source: Add states to a gameplay enum and recheck its users
entries.text: 为玩法枚举添加状态并复查使用者

entries.source: Absolute path on disk; the first column holds the row names
entries.text: 磁盘上的绝对路径；第一列为行名

entries.source: Import a CSV file into a DataTable on an existing row struct, check every column matched, and prove the row count and sample values.
entries.text: 基于已有的行结构体把 CSV 文件导入数据表，检查每一列都已匹配，并验证行数和抽样数值。

entries.source: Import a CSV of enemy stats into a DataTable
entries.text: 把敌人属性 CSV 导入数据表

entries.source: Make an item-type enum and an item row struct, create a DataTable on them with starter rows, and prove fields, values and row count.
entries.text: 创建物品类型枚举和物品行结构体，基于它们建立数据表并填入初始行，验证字段、数值和行数。

entries.source: Build an item DataTable from a new struct and enum
entries.text: 用新的结构体和枚举创建物品数据表

entries.source: Rewrite one CurveTable row's keys from a formula, keep it rising level to level, and prove the key count, range and values against the spec.
entries.text: 按公式重写曲线表中某一行的关键帧，确保逐级递增，并对照规格验证关键帧数量、范围和数值。

entries.source: Rebalance a level-up curve in a CurveTable
entries.text: 重新平衡曲线表中的升级曲线

entries.source: Rename one field of a user-defined struct through a checked, hash-sealed plan, then prove the struct and the Blueprints using it still load clean.
entries.text: 通过经过检查、以哈希封装的计划重命名用户定义结构体的一个字段，然后证明结构体及使用它的蓝图仍能正常加载。

entries.source: Rename a struct field safely across the project
entries.text: 在整个项目中安全地重命名结构体字段

entries.source: Create a String Table with stable keys for a screen's text, verify its id, namespace and keys, and say how each key is referenced.
entries.text: 为某个界面的文本创建带稳定键的字符串表，核对其 ID、命名空间和键，并说明每个键的引用方式。

entries.source: Collect UI strings into a localizable String Table
entries.text: 把 UI 文本收集到可本地化的字符串表

场地包围盒最小点（厘米）

entries.source: Cost-report just the arena's box, compare it with draw-call, triangle, light and translucency budgets, and name the worst offenders.
entries.text: 只统计场地包围盒内的开销，与绘制调用、三角形、灯光和半透明预算对比，并指出最严重的超标项。

entries.source: Check a combat arena stays within its frame budget
entries.text: 检查战斗场地是否在帧预算之内

entries.source: 8-64 letters, digits, _ or -; the same id polls the same audit
entries.text: 8-64 个字母、数字、下划线或连字符；用同一 ID 轮询同一次审计

entries.source: Start a bounded audit job, page through every finding, and rank the problems by severity with the object each one names.
entries.text: 启动有界审计任务，逐页读取所有发现，并按严重程度排序，注明每个问题涉及的对象。

entries.source: Run a project audit and triage the findings
entries.text: 运行项目审计并对问题分级

entries.source: List a folder's Blueprints, compile the suspect ones, and report every error with the graph and node it sits on.
entries.text: 列出文件夹中的蓝图，编译可疑的蓝图，并报告每个错误所在的图表和节点。

entries.source: Find Blueprints with compile errors in a folder
entries.text: 找出文件夹中编译出错的蓝图

entries.source: Gather engine version, platform, build configuration, live packs, plugin readiness and recent errors into one paste-ready block.
entries.text: 汇总引擎版本、平台、构建配置、可用工具包、插件就绪状态和最近错误，生成可直接粘贴的信息块。

entries.source: Collect an environment block for a bug report
entries.text: 为缺陷报告收集环境信息

entries.source: Profile, make one change, profile again the same way, and report what got better or worse with the bound before and after.
entries.text: 先分析一次，做一处改动，再用相同方式分析，报告哪些变好或变差，以及前后的瓶颈。

entries.source: Compare performance before and after a change
How many levels of referencers to follow
entries.text: 向上追溯引用者的层数

entries.source: List the assets that use the selected asset up to a set depth, noting registry readiness and unsaved changes, before you move or delete it.
entries.text: 在移动或删除选中资产前，按指定深度列出引用它的资产，并注明资产注册表状态和未保存的改动。

entries.source: Find everything that references an asset
entries.text: 找出引用某个资产的所有内容

entries.source: Walk what a Blueprint loads with it, find the heavy chains such as a character pulling in every weapon, and suggest where to go soft.
entries.text: 梳理蓝图连带加载的内容，找出沉重的引用链（如角色加载全部武器），并建议改为软引用的位置。

entries.source: Find hard references that bloat a Blueprint's memory
entries.text: 找出导致蓝图内存膨胀的硬引用
非 Nanite 三角形预算

entries.source: Estimate draw calls, triangles, shadow casters, lights and translucency for the loaded level, and list its heaviest actors and meshes.
entries.text: 估算已加载关卡的绘制调用、三角形数、阴影投射体、灯光和半透明数量，并列出开销最大的 Actor 和网格体。

entries.source: Measure the rendering cost of the open level
entries.text: 测量当前关卡的渲染开销

entries.source: Count lights by type and mobility, overlapping shadow casters and tiny shadow casters, then dry-run the light changes that would help.
entries.text: 按类型和移动性统计灯光、重叠的投影灯和微小阴影投射体，并以试运行方式列出有帮助的灯光改动。

entries.source: Audit lights and shadow casters for performance
entries.text: 从性能角度审查灯光和阴影投射体

entries.source: 0 reads now; 1 to 10 also measures cost
entries.text: 0 表示立即读取；1 到 10 还会测量开销

entries.source: Sample the running game: Nanite's streaming pool and fallback meshes, Niagara systems with their particles, caps and cost, and renderer settings.
entries.text: 采样运行中的游戏：Nanite 流送池和回退网格、Niagara 系统的粒子、上限和开销，以及渲染器设置。

entries.source: Read Nanite and Niagara live during play
entries.text: 游玩时实时读取 Nanite 和 Niagara

entries.source: Mark the log, let a bot play the level, then list just the new errors and warnings by category with the assets they name.
entries.text: 先标记日志位置，让机器人试玩关卡，再按类别列出新增的错误和警告及其涉及的资产。

entries.source: Play the level and list only the new log errors
entries.text: 试玩关卡并只列出新增的日志错误

entries.source: Compare the editor and Play In Editor costs of a level, read the last frame's draw calls, and profile the play session's frame.
entries.text: 比较关卡在编辑器中和编辑器内游玩时的开销，读取最后一帧的绘制调用，并分析游玩会话的帧。

entries.source: Measure a level's rendering cost during play
entries.text: 测量关卡运行时的渲染开销
资产将要移动到的文件夹

entries.source: Check each selected asset is on disk, saved, compiles and is free to edit, and that its name is free in the target folder.
entries.text: 检查每个选中资产是否在磁盘上、已保存、能编译且可编辑，以及目标文件夹中是否已有同名资产。

entries.source: Preflight selected assets before a move or rename
entries.text: 移动或重命名前预检选中的资产

entries.source: Explore, Survive, Collect, Defeat or Reach
Let the playtest bot explore or fight while the session is measured, then report frame time, hitches and where they happened.
entries.text: 让测试机器人探索或战斗，同时测量会话，然后报告帧时间、卡顿及其发生位置。

entries.source: Profile the game while the bot plays a route
entries.text: 在机器人跑路线时分析游戏性能

entries.source: Measure Play In Editor, say whether it is game-thread, render-thread, RHI or GPU bound or capped, and list its hitches and hot functions.
entries.text: 测量编辑器内游玩，判断是游戏线程、渲染线程、RHI 还是 GPU 受限或被帧率上限限制，并列出卡顿和热点函数。

entries.source: Profile a play session and find what bounds it
entries.text: 分析一次游玩会话并找出瓶颈

entries.source: Discover tests, confirm the named ones exist and can run, run them with Epic's automation tools, and report each pass and failure.
entries.text: 发现测试，确认指定测试存在且可运行，再用 Epic 自动化工具执行，并逐条报告通过与失败。

entries.source: Run automation tests by name and report results
entries.text: 按名称运行自动化测试并报告结果

entries.text: 在选中的地形上铺设碎石伐木道并绘制路肩，建模阔叶树、灌木和枯立木，生长出让道路保持畅通的森林。

entries.source: Dress a logging road through an autumn hardwood forest
entries.text: 为穿过秋季阔叶林的伐木道布景

entries.text: 图层混合中包含本配方各绘制图层名称的现有地形材质；填 none 则新建一个以纯色显示各图层的材质。

entries.source: Shape a bay with beach, dunes and cliffs, lay the village road and house plots, model a lighthouse and rocks, and grow dune grass and scrub.
entries.text: 塑造带沙滩、沙丘和悬崖的海湾，铺设村路并预留房屋地块，建模灯塔和岩石，生长沙丘草和灌木。

entries.source: Build a coastal fishing village on a sheltered bay
entries.text: 在避风海湾搭建海边渔村

entries.source: An existing landscape material whose layer blend names this recipe's paint layers, or none to make one that shows each layer in a flat colour.
entries.text: 图层混合中包含本配方各绘制图层名称的现有地形材质；填 none 则新建一个以纯色显示各图层的材质。

entries.source: Carve a winding canyon with ridged walls, paint crystal fields in patches, model crystal clusters and boulders, and grow them beside the trail.
entries.text: 开凿两侧为山脊岩壁的蜿蜒峡谷，成片绘制水晶区，建模水晶簇和巨石，并沿小径生长。

entries.source: Build a crystal-lined canyon approach to a cavern
entries.text: 搭建通往洞穴、两侧布满水晶的峡谷

entries.source: An existing landscape material whose layer blend names this recipe's paint layers, or none to make one that shows each layer in a flat colour.
entries.text: 图层混合中包含本配方各绘制图层名称的现有地形材质；填 none 则新建一个以纯色显示各图层的材质。

entries.source: Ridged dunes round a flattened oasis with a sunken pool basin, sand, grass and rock painted, modeled palms, bushes and rocks grown only where they belong.
entries.text: 山脊状沙丘环绕着整平的绿洲及其下陷的水池盆地，绘制沙地、草地和岩石，建模的棕榈、灌木和岩石只在合适的地方生长。

entries.source: Build a desert oasis with dunes, palms and a dry pool
entries.text: 搭建有沙丘、棕榈和干涸水池的沙漠绿洲

entries.source: An existing landscape material whose layer blend names this recipe's paint layers, or none to make one that shows each layer in a flat colour.
entries.text: 图层混合中包含本配方各绘制图层名称的现有地形材质；填 none 则新建一个以纯色显示各图层的材质。

entries.text: 500 米地形上有阳光照耀的空地、小路和古老森林：建模的树木、灌木和蘑菇由 PCG 生长在一棵巨树周围。

entries.source: Build a fantasy glade around an ancient giant tree
entries.text: 围绕一棵远古巨树搭建奇幻林间空地

entries.source: Cost-report a PCG forest, cut species density and cull distances in its ecosystem, regenerate, and prove the savings with the same report.
entries.text: 对 PCG 森林做开销报告，在生态系统中降低物种密度和剔除距离，重新生成，并用同一份报告证明节省效果。

entries.source: Make a dense forest scene fit its render budget
entries.text: 让茂密森林场景符合渲染预算

entries.source: Lowland band (m above the lowest ground)
entries.text: 低地范围（高于最低地面的米数）
