entries.text: 在选中地形的低处绘制蘑菇区，建模巨型和小型蘑菇以及枯树干，并按从大到小的顺序生长。

entries.source: Grow a giant mushroom forest on a landscape's lowlands
entries.text: 在地形低地上生长巨型蘑菇森林

entries.source: An image path to compare the aerial shot with, or none.
entries.text: 用于与航拍图对比的图像路径，或填 none。

entries.source: Set a warm low sun, sky, fog and locked exposure on a dressed scene, then capture an aerial, a mid and a ground shot and check their metrics.
entries.text: 为已布置的场景设置温暖的低角度太阳、天空、雾和锁定曝光，然后拍摄航拍、中景和地面三张图并检查其指标。

entries.source: Light a finished environment and take three hero shots
entries.text: 为完成的环境打光并拍摄三张主视觉图

entries.source: Raise a hill, wind a road to its top, model a tower, walls, an arch and pillars, set them on the summit and grow scrub that keeps clear of them.
entries.text: 堆起一座山并修一条蜿蜒通到山顶的路，建模塔楼、墙体、拱门和立柱放在山顶，生长避开废墟的灌木。

entries.source: Build hilltop ruins with a broken tower and a winding road
entries.text: 搭建有残塔和盘山路的山顶废墟

entries.source: A four-lane highway across rolling country, broken concrete barriers, and grass and bushes pushing through the verges and the cracked asphalt.
entries.text: 横穿起伏乡野的四车道高速公路、破碎的混凝土隔离墩，以及从路肩和开裂沥青中钻出的草和灌木。
搭建杂草丛生的废弃高速公路

entries.source: Read the selected PCG graph's recipes, prove it generates and cleans up on a small test volume, then grow it over a region and check what grew.
entries.text: 读取选中 PCG 图表的配方，在小测试体积上证明它能生成并清理干净，然后在区域中生成并检查结果。

entries.source: Prove a PCG generator, then dress an area with it
entries.text: 先验证 PCG 生成器，再用它布置区域

entries.source: A hex colour painted into the models' vertex colour.
entries.text: 写入模型顶点色的十六进制颜色。

entries.source: Flatten a pad on the selected landscape, model broken walls, pillars and an arch, place them on the ground and scatter rubble round them.
entries.text: 在选中的地形上整平一块场地，建模残墙、立柱和拱门，把它们放到地面上，并在周围散布碎石。

entries.source: Build a ruined courtyard with arches, walls and rubble
entries.text: 搭建带拱门、残墙和碎石的废墟庭院

entries.source: An existing landscape material whose layer blend names this recipe's paint layers, or none to make one that shows each layer in a flat colour.
entries.text: 图层混合中包含本配方各绘制图层名称的现有地形材质；填 none 则新建一个以纯色显示各图层的材质。

entries.source: Ridged peaks, a trail levelled through the saddle, snow by height and rock by slope, and modeled pines and boulders grown below the treeline.
entries.text: 山脊状群峰、穿过垭口并被整平的小径、按高度铺雪按坡度露岩，建模的松树和巨石生长在林线以下。

entries.source: Build a snowy mountain pass with a treeline forest
entries.text: 搭建带林线森林的雪山垭口

entries.source: Model standing stones and grass tufts, set the stones in a ring on the selected landscape with foliage, and grass the meadow round them.
entries.text: 建模立石和草丛，用植被系统在选中地形上把立石摆成一圈，并在周围铺满草地。

entries.source: Raise a stone circle in a grassy meadow
entries.text: 在草地上立起一圈巨石阵

entries.source: An existing landscape material whose layer blend names this recipe's paint layers, or none to make one that shows each layer in a flat colour.
entries.text: 图层混合中包含本配方各绘制图层名称的现有地形材质；填 none 则新建一个以纯色显示各图层的材质。

entries.source: Flat wetland with sunken mud pools, reeds at the waterline, dead trunks and toadstools on hummocks and a boardwalk route kept clear.
entries.text: 平坦湿地中有下陷的泥潭，水边长芦苇，较干的土丘上有枯树和毒蘑菇，并保持木栈道路线畅通。

entries.source: Build a swamp of dead trees, reeds and mud pools
entries.text: 搭建有枯树、芦苇和泥潭的沼泽

entries.source: Comma-separated pairs of an Input Action name and an Unreal key name
entries.text: 用逗号分隔的“输入动作名=Unreal 按键名”组合

entries.source: Mirror keyboard controls onto a controller in the selected Mapping Context, skip pairs already bound, and prove the keys show up in play.
entries.text: 在所选映射上下文中把键盘操作对应到手柄，跳过已绑定的组合，并在运行中证明这些按键已生效。

entries.source: Add gamepad bindings to a keyboard mapping context
entries.text: 为键盘映射上下文添加手柄按键

entries.source: Content folder that holds the Input Actions and Mapping Contexts
entries.text: 存放输入动作和映射上下文的内容文件夹

entries.source: Read every Input Action and Mapping Context in a folder, list key conflicts, duplicates and unused actions, and check what is live in play.
entries.text: 读取文件夹中所有输入动作和映射上下文，列出按键冲突、重复映射和未使用的动作，并检查运行时实际生效的操作。

entries.source: Audit Enhanced Input for conflicts and unused actions
entries.text: 审查 Enhanced Input 的按键冲突与未用动作

entries.source: Add a Hold and Release trigger to the heavy-attack mapping so the strike lands on release after a charge, and read the mapping back.
entries.text: 为重击映射添加“按住并松开”触发器，让蓄力后松手才出招，并读回映射确认。

entries.source: Charge a heavy attack: hold, then release to strike
entries.text: 蓄力重击：按住后松开出招

entries.source: Trace an action from its mappings to the contexts registered in Play In Editor, inject it, and name the broken link: key, context, priority or binding.
entries.text: 从映射追踪到 PIE 中实际注册的上下文，注入该动作，并指出断开的环节：按键、上下文、优先级还是绑定。

entries.source: Find out why an input does nothing in play
entries.text: 排查某个输入在运行中为何没反应

entries.source: Longest gap between the two taps
entries.text: 两次点击之间允许的最长间隔

entries.source: Create a dodge action fired by double-tapping W, A, S or D with a Repeated Tap trigger, add it to the selected context, and validate it.
entries.text: 创建由双击 W、A、S、D 触发的闪避动作（重复点击触发器），加入所选映射上下文并完成验证。

entries.source: Add a double-tap dodge on the movement keys
entries.text: 用移动键双击触发闪避

entries.source: Name or object path of the 2D movement action used for the play check
entries.text: 用于运行检查的二维移动动作名称或对象路径

entries.source: Find actions flagged for value-type loss, retype them in one plan, recompile the Blueprints that bind them, and prove movement still drives the pawn.
entries.text: 找出被标记为值类型丢失的动作，在一个计划里改成正确的类型，重新编译绑定它们的蓝图，并证明移动仍能驱动角色。

entries.source: Fix Input Actions whose value type drops an axis
entries.text: 修复值类型丢失轴向的输入动作

entries.source: Property on the player pawn that drops by one per shot
entries.text: 玩家角色上每射击一次减一的属性

entries.source: Add a Pulse trigger to the fire action so holding it fires at a fixed rate, read the trigger back, and hold fire in play to count shots.
entries.text: 为开火动作添加脉冲触发器，按住即按固定射速连发，读回触发器设置，并在运行中按住开火统计射击次数。

entries.source: Turn the fire action into full-auto at a set fire rate
entries.text: 把开火动作改为按设定射速全自动

entries.source: Seal a readiness preflight for a Game Feature, activate it with Epic's tool, confirm it reaches Active without errors, play it, and restore its state.
entries.text: 为 Game Feature 封存就绪预检，用 Epic 工具激活，确认无错误地进入 Active 状态，实际游玩后恢复原状态。

entries.source: Preflight and activate a Game Feature, then play it
entries.text: 预检并激活 Game Feature，再实际游玩

entries.source: Record sealed fingerprints of a Game Feature's data, Mass config and schema in project memory, and on later runs report exactly which part changed.
entries.text: 把 Game Feature 的数据、Mass 配置和 Schema 的封存指纹记入项目记忆，之后每次运行准确报告哪一部分发生了变化。

entries.source: Catch drift in a Game Feature's Mass setup
entries.text: 捕捉 Game Feature 的 Mass 配置漂移

entries.source: Preflight a project Game Feature's data asset, Mass entity config and world condition schema, and report exactly what blocks it.
entries.text: 预检项目 Game Feature 的数据资产、Mass 实体配置和世界条件 Schema，并准确报告阻碍就绪的原因。

entries.source: Check a Game Feature is ready for Mass crowds
entries.text: 检查 Game Feature 是否已为 Mass 人群就绪

entries.source: Add a Hold trigger to the Interact action so doors and levers need a deliberate press, read it back, and hold it in play.
entries.text: 为交互动作添加按住触发器，让开门和拉杆需要刻意按住，读回设置并在运行中按住验证。

entries.source: Make Interact a hold with a short charge time
entries.text: 把交互改为需要短暂按住

entries.source: Find Input Actions that no context maps and nothing references, and prepare a removal plan that is checked but not run, for you to approve.
entries.text: 找出没有被任何上下文映射、也没有被引用的输入动作，并准备一个只检查不执行的删除计划供你批准。

entries.source: List unused Input Actions before a cleanup
entries.text: 清理前列出未使用的输入动作

entries.source: Camera actor framing the character; leave empty for the level viewport
entries.text: 对准角色的相机 Actor；留空则使用关卡视口

entries.source: Preflight height, build and body fat for the selected MetaHuman, apply them through Epic's MetaHuman tools, then validate and compare before and after.
entries.text: 为所选 MetaHuman 预检身高、肌肉量和体脂，通过 Epic 的 MetaHuman 工具应用，再验证并对比修改前后。

entries.source: Reshape a MetaHuman's body to a character brief
entries.text: 按角色设定重塑 MetaHuman 体型

entries.source: Give each selected MetaHuman distinct height, build, skin and eyes within ranges you set, preflight every one, apply, validate, and capture a lineup.
entries.text: 在你设定的范围内为每个所选 MetaHuman 分配不同的身高、体型、肤色和瞳色，逐个预检、应用、验证，并拍摄阵容合照。

entries.source: Vary a cast of MetaHuman NPCs so no two look alike
entries.text: 让一组 MetaHuman NPC 各不相同

entries.source: Read the selected MetaHuman characters' identity, flag unsaved, unloaded or wrong-class assets, and validate the snapshot before anyone edits them.
entries.text: 读取所选 MetaHuman 角色的身份信息，标出未保存、未加载或类型不对的资产，并在编辑前验证快照。

entries.source: Check MetaHumans are saved and ready to edit
entries.text: 检查 MetaHuman 是否已保存并可编辑

entries.source: 0 is cool (blue, grey, green), 1 is warm (brown, amber, hazel)
entries.text: 0 为冷色（蓝、灰、绿），1 为暖色（棕、琥珀、榛色）

entries.source: Epic's scale: 0 is light skin, 1 is dark
entries.text: Epic 的标度：0 为浅色皮肤，1 为深色

entries.source: Preflight skin lightness, redness and eye colour for the selected MetaHuman, apply them with Epic's tools, and prove the look with close-ups.
entries.text: 为所选 MetaHuman 预检肤色明度、红润度和眼睛颜色，用 Epic 工具应用，并用特写画面证明效果。

entries.source: Match a MetaHuman's skin tone and eye colour to a brief
entries.text: 按设定调整 MetaHuman 肤色与瞳色

entries.source: Object path of the Input Action that pauses the game
entries.text: 负责暂停游戏的输入动作的对象路径

entries.source: Set an Input Action to trigger while paused so the same key opens and closes the pause menu, then press it twice in play.
entries.text: 把输入动作设为暂停时也能触发，让同一个键既能打开也能关闭暂停菜单，然后在运行中按两次验证。

entries.source: Let the pause action work while the game is paused
entries.text: 让暂停动作在游戏暂停时仍然生效

entries.source: Make move, look, jump and sprint actions and a default context, bind them in the selected character Blueprint, and prove it moves, jumps and sprints.
entries.text: 创建移动、视角、跳跃、冲刺动作和默认上下文，在所选角色蓝图中绑定，并证明角色能移动、跳跃和冲刺。

entries.source: Set up third-person controls and bind them in a Blueprint
entries.text: 搭建第三人称操作并在蓝图中绑定

entries.source: Give both sticks a radial dead zone, the look stick a response curve, and mouse look a sensitivity and optional invert-Y, then read every value back.
entries.text: 为两个摇杆加入径向死区、为视角摇杆加入响应曲线、为鼠标视角设置灵敏度和可选的 Y 轴反转，并读回每个数值。

entries.source: Tune aiming: stick dead zone, curve and mouse invert-Y
entries.text: 调校瞄准：摇杆死区、响应曲线与鼠标 Y 轴反转

entries.source: Create throttle, steer and handbrake actions and an IMC_Vehicle context with keyboard and gamepad keys, reverse keys negated, steering smoothed, all validated.
entries.text: 创建油门、转向、手刹动作和 IMC_Vehicle 上下文，绑定键盘与手柄按键，对反向键取反并让转向平滑，全部通过验证。

entries.source: Build driving controls: throttle, steering and handbrake
entries.text: 搭建驾驶操作：油门、转向和手刹

entries.source: Create a cooldown effect that grants a cooldown tag for a set time and attach it to the selected ability, reading both back.
entries.text: 创建在设定时间内授予冷却标签的冷却效果，挂到所选能力上，并读回两者确认。

entries.source: Add a cooldown to the selected Gameplay Ability
entries.text: 为所选 Gameplay Ability 添加冷却

entries.source: Read every ability and effect in a folder, flag missing costs and cooldowns, cue tags without notifies and compile errors, and change nothing.
entries.text: 读取文件夹中所有能力和效果，标出缺少的消耗与冷却、没有通知资产的 Cue 标签和编译错误，不做任何修改。

entries.source: Audit Gameplay Abilities and Effects for setup gaps
entries.text: 审查 Gameplay Ability 与 Effect 的配置缺口

entries.source: Create a periodic fire effect that ticks damage on a timer, grants a Burning tag and plays one non-stacking cue, then validate it.
entries.text: 创建按时跳伤的周期性火焰效果，授予燃烧标签并只播放一次不叠加的 Cue，然后完成验证。

entries.source: Make a burning damage-over-time effect with a cue
entries.text: 制作带 Cue 的燃烧持续伤害效果

entries.source: Set activation, cancel and block tag rules on three abilities so a dodge cancels attacks, heavy blocks light, and nothing double-fires, then validate.
entries.text: 为三个能力设置激活、取消与封锁标签规则：闪避取消攻击、重击封锁轻击、不会重复触发，然后验证。

entries.source: Wire combo rules so light, heavy and dodge cancel cleanly
entries.text: 设定连招规则，让轻击、重击与闪避干净地互相取消

entries.source: Make a dash with a stamina cost, grant it on the selected character, trigger it by tag from an input action, and prove stamina drops in play.
entries.text: 制作消耗耐力的闪冲能力，授予所选角色，通过输入动作按标签触发，并在运行中证明耐力确实下降。

entries.source: Grant a dash ability, trigger it from input, prove it
entries.text: 授予闪冲能力、由输入触发并在游戏中验证

entries.source: Make an instant heal effect, a potion-charge cost and a Drink Potion ability that cannot be used while dead, and read all three back.
entries.text: 创建瞬时治疗效果、药水次数消耗和死亡时无法使用的饮用药水能力，并读回三者确认。

entries.source: Create a healing potion ability with a charge cost
entries.text: 制作带次数消耗的治疗药水能力

entries.source: Create two infinite periodic effects that restore health and mana on a timer, tagged so other effects can find them, and read them back.
entries.text: 创建两个无限持续的周期性效果，定时恢复生命和法力，并打上便于其他效果查找的标签，最后读回确认。

entries.source: Add health and mana regeneration effects
entries.text: 添加生命与法力自然恢复效果

entries.source: The meta attribute your damage code reads; use Health if you have none
entries.text: 伤害代码读取的元属性；若没有就用 Health

entries.source: Create a stamina cost, a short stagger hit with Set By Caller damage and a heavy-attack ability that pays the cost and is blocked while staggered.
entries.text: 创建耐力消耗、带 Set By Caller 伤害的短暂硬直命中效果，以及支付消耗、硬直时无法释放的重击能力。

entries.source: Make a heavy attack that costs stamina and staggers
entries.text: 制作消耗耐力并造成硬直的重击

entries.source: Give the selected effects hit or status cues, register the cue tags, create missing notify assets with Epic's tool, and set the cue flags.
entries.text: 为所选效果加上命中或状态 Cue，注册 Cue 标签，用 Epic 工具创建缺失的通知资产，并设置 Cue 标志。

entries.source: Hook up gameplay cues on the selected effects
entries.text: 为所选效果接上 Gameplay Cue

entries.source: Abilities whose name contains one of these run on the server only
entries.text: 名称包含其中任一词的能力只在服务器上运行
仅服务器能力名称包含

entries.source: Classify each selected ability as client-predicted or server-only, set instancing and net execution policy in one checked plan, and smoke-test a listen server.
entries.text: 把每个所选能力归类为客户端预测或仅服务器执行，在一个经过检查的计划中设置实例化与网络执行策略，并做监听服务器冒烟测试。

entries.source: Set multiplayer net policies on the selected abilities
entries.text: 为所选能力设置多人联机网络策略

entries.source: An attribute name such as Health, or all
entries.text: 属性名（如 Health），或填 all

entries.source: Scale the constant modifiers on the selected effects by a percentage, skip any effect a rewrite would damage, and show before and after.
entries.text: 按百分比缩放所选效果上的常量修改器，跳过重写会造成损坏的效果，并列出修改前后对比。

entries.source: Rebalance the selected Gameplay Effects by a percentage
entries.text: 按百分比重新平衡所选 Gameplay Effect

entries.source: Create a speed buff, a periodic stamina drain and a Sprint ability blocked when exhausted and predicted on the client, then validate them.
entries.text: 创建速度增益、周期性耐力消耗，以及力竭时无法使用并在客户端预测的冲刺能力，然后完成验证。

entries.source: Make a sprint ability that drains stamina over time
entries.text: 制作持续消耗耐力的冲刺能力

entries.source: Abilities whose asset tags sit under this tag cannot start while stunned
entries.text: 资产标签位于此标签下的能力在眩晕时无法启动

entries.source: Create a stun effect that grants a Stunned tag and blocks all abilities, and make the selected abilities refuse to start while stunned.
entries.text: 创建授予眩晕标签并封锁全部能力的眩晕效果，并让所选能力在眩晕期间无法启动。

entries.source: Make a stun that blocks every ability for two seconds
entries.text: 制作两秒内封锁所有能力的眩晕

entries.source: Create Set By Caller bullet damage, a one-round ammo cost, a fire-rate cooldown and a Fire ability that uses them, then validate all four.
entries.text: 创建 Set By Caller 子弹伤害、每发一枚的弹药消耗、射速冷却，以及使用它们的开火能力，然后验证这四项资产。

entries.source: Build weapon damage, ammo cost and fire rate with GAS
entries.text: 用 GAS 构建武器伤害、弹药消耗与射速

entries.source: Draw one base image of a subject, then relight that same picture in four moods, so the directions compare like for like.
entries.text: 先画出主题的基础图，再把同一张图重新打光成四种氛围，让各方向在相同构图下对比。

entries.source: Explore four art-direction moods on one composition
entries.text: 在同一构图上探索四种美术方向

entries.source: Capture a blockout from a camera and have an image model render its flat shapes as finished materials, keeping the layout.
entries.text: 从相机截取白模画面，让图像模型把纯色形体渲染成最终材质，同时保持布局不变。

entries.source: Paint a greybox view into a finished-look keyframe
entries.text: 把灰盒视角绘制成完成效果关键帧

entries.source: PNG or JPEG path relative to the project folder
entries.text: 相对项目文件夹的 PNG 或 JPEG 路径

entries.source: Lock exposure, then change one lighting setting at a time and re-score against the reference until it reaches the target.
entries.text: 锁定曝光后每次只改一项光照设置，并对照参考图重新评分，直到达到目标分数。

entries.source: Match the level's lighting to a reference image
entries.text: 让关卡光照匹配参考图

entries.source: look for concept art or photos; aligned when the reference frames the same view
entries.text: 概念图或照片用 look；参考图与截图视角相同时用 aligned

entries.source: Path relative to the project folder, or newest for the latest generated reference
entries.text: 相对项目文件夹的路径；填 newest 则使用最新生成的参考图

entries.source: Capture a camera view and compare it with a reference, reporting the score, the worst regions and the top fixes; no edits.
entries.text: 截取相机画面并与参考图比较，报告总分、差距最大的区域和最该改的几项；不做任何修改。

entries.source: Score how far the level is from a reference image
entries.text: 评估关卡与参考图的差距

entries.source: Capture the match camera, have an image model relight that exact frame for a new mood, and score the starting gap.
entries.text: 截取匹配相机画面，让图像模型为同一画面换成新的光照氛围，并给出起始差距评分。

entries.source: Relight the current view as a reference image
entries.text: 把当前视角重新打光生成参考图

entries.source: Read an earlier reference's prompt from its sidecar, render it again on a better model at 2K, and check it kept the look.
entries.text: 从附带的 JSON 说明文件读取旧参考图的提示词，换用更好的模型以 2K 重绘，并确认风格未变。

entries.source: Re-render an earlier reference at higher quality
entries.text: 以更高质量重绘之前的参考图

entries.source: Say where the main light comes from and what casts it
entries.text: 说明主光从哪个方向来、由什么发出

entries.source: Fill the scene_reference template with time of day, key light, palette and mood, check the prompt for free, then draw it.
entries.text: 在 scene_reference 模板中填入时段、主光、配色和氛围，先免费检查提示词，再生成图片。

entries.source: Generate a lighting reference from the scene template
entries.text: 用场景模板生成光照参考图

entries.source: Snow on the top (% of relief)
Create a ridged-noise mountain landscape, soften its spikes, paint scree, rock cliffs and a snow line from the measured relief, then verify.
entries.text: 用山脊噪声创建山地地形，柔化尖刺，按实测起伏绘制碎石、岩壁和雪线，然后验证。

entries.source: Raise a ridged alpine range with snowcaps
entries.text: 隆起带积雪的山脊状高山山脉

entries.source: Read back each landscape's size, relief, material, paint coverage and edit layers, flag problems in a table, and change nothing.
entries.text: 回读每个地形的尺寸、起伏、材质、图层覆盖率和编辑图层，在表格中标出问题，不做任何修改。

entries.source: Audit every landscape in the level
entries.text: 审查关卡中的所有地形

entries.source: Lay a forest layer in noise patches over a set share of the gentle ground, meadow between and rock on cliffs, then measure the mosaic.
entries.text: 按设定比例在平缓地面上以噪声斑块铺设森林图层，其间为草甸，陡崖为岩石，然后测量镶嵌效果。

entries.source: Paint a forest and meadow mosaic in patches
entries.text: 以斑块形式绘制森林与草甸镶嵌地表

entries.source: Create a dune field from ridged noise, flatten a pad for an outpost, paint sand, hardpan and rock, and sample the pad's flatness.
entries.text: 用山脊噪声生成沙丘地带，为前哨平整一块地，绘制沙地、硬地和岩石，并采样检查地块平整度。

entries.source: Shape a desert of dunes around a flat outpost pad
entries.text: 塑造沙丘沙漠并平整前哨基地地块

entries.source: Lay a landscape spline road through points, level and paint it, paint verges by distance from it, and sample its grade.
entries.text: 沿指定点生成地形样条道路，压平并绘制路面，按与道路的距离绘制路边草带，并采样道路坡度。

entries.source: Lay a dirt road with grass verges through points
entries.text: 沿指定点铺设带草边的土路

entries.source: Flatten a pad at its ground height on the selected landscape, grade a ramp under 30 degrees up to it, and sample both.
entries.text: 在所选地形上按原地面高度平整地块，修一条低于 30 度的坡道通向它，并对两者采样。

entries.source: Level a building pad with a walkable ramp
entries.text: 平整建筑地块并修一条可行走坡道

entries.source: Raise a rim, dig the bowl and add noise on a removable edit layer, paint scorched ground around it, then measure the depth and rim height.
entries.text: 在可删除的编辑图层中抬起坑缘、下挖坑体并加噪声，在周围绘制焦土，然后测量坑深和坑缘高度。

entries.source: Blast a sci-fi impact crater on its own edit layer
entries.text: 在独立编辑图层上炸出科幻撞击坑

entries.source: Meters from pure black to pure white in the heightmap.
entries.text: 高度图从纯黑到纯白对应的米数。

entries.source: Build a landscape from the selected 16-bit heightmap at a real-world size and height range, then check its relief and look for stair-stepping.
entries.text: 用所选 16 位高度图按真实尺寸和高度范围生成地形，再检查起伏并查看是否有台阶状伪影。

entries.source: Import a heightmap texture as a new landscape
entries.text: 将高度图纹理导入为新地形

entries.source: Make a landscape material showing each paint layer in a flat colour, set it on the selected landscape, and prove every painted layer shows.
entries.text: 制作每个绘制图层对应一种纯色的地形材质，指定给所选地形，并证明每个已绘制图层都能显示。

entries.source: Make a layer-blend material for a landscape
entries.text: 为地形制作图层混合材质

entries.source: An image file inside the project, such as a generated reference, concept art or a photo.
entries.text: 项目内的图像文件，例如生成的参考图、概念图或照片。

entries.source: Frame a view like the reference, then sculpt and repaint the selected landscape in measured rounds until the image score reaches the target.
entries.text: 按参考图构图取景，然后分轮雕刻并重绘所选地形，直到图像评分达到目标。

entries.source: Shape and paint terrain to match a reference image
entries.text: 按参考图塑形并绘制地形

entries.source: Add a texture_patch modifier that stamps the selected heightmap onto a Mesh Terrain at a set place and scale, then validate and capture it.
entries.text: 添加 texture_patch 修改器，把所选高度图按指定位置和缩放盖印到网格地形上，然后验证并截图。

entries.source: Stamp a heightmap onto a Mesh Terrain
entries.text: 将高度图盖印到网格地形上

entries.source: Create an experimental Mesh Partition terrain of a set size and spacing, add a noise modifier, then validate it and capture the result.
entries.text: 按设定尺寸和间距创建实验性的网格分区地形，添加噪声修改器，然后验证并截图。

entries.source: Create a Mesh Terrain with rolling noise
entries.text: 创建带起伏噪声的网格地形
要移除的修改器（或 none）

entries.source: Change a terrain's noise intensity, add a remesh pass and remove a stray modifier through a dry run, then prove the rebuild is clean.
entries.text: 经试运行后修改地形噪声强度、添加重网格处理并移除多余修改器，然后证明重建干净无误。

entries.source: Retune a Mesh Terrain's modifiers in place
entries.text: 就地重新调整网格地形的修改器

entries.source: Add a spline modifier through set points to cut a road or river bed into a Mesh Terrain, tune its width from its own settings, and validate.
entries.text: 沿指定点添加样条修改器，在网格地形上切出道路或河床，按其自身设置调整宽度，并进行验证。

entries.source: Carve a road or river bed into a Mesh Terrain
entries.text: 在网格地形上切出道路或河床

entries.source: Dry-run then build a large World Partition landscape split into streaming proxies, check proxies, relief and grid, and ask before saving.
entries.text: 先试运行再生成拆分为流送代理的大型世界分区地形，检查代理、起伏和网格，保存前先询问。

entries.source: Create a 4 km open-world landscape that streams
entries.text: 创建可流送的 4 公里开放世界地形

entries.source: Add any missing paint layers to the selected landscape, paint them by slope and elevation bands with broken edges, and measure each layer's share.
entries.text: 为所选地形补齐缺失的绘制图层，按坡度和海拔带绘制并打散边缘，再测量每个图层的占比。

entries.source: Paint grass, rock and snow by slope and height
entries.text: 按坡度和高度绘制草地、岩石和积雪

entries.source: A static mesh path laid along the track, or none.
entries.text: 沿赛道铺设的静态网格路径；填 none 则不铺设。

entries.source: Lay a closed spline track through corner points, flatten an infield paddock, paint asphalt and run-off, and check grades and camber.
entries.text: 沿弯道点铺设封闭样条赛道，平整内场围场，绘制沥青和缓冲区，并检查坡度和横坡。

entries.source: Lay a closed racing circuit with a flat paddock
entries.text: 铺设带平整围场的封闭赛道

entries.source: Rounded to whole 126 m components at 100 cm per vertex: 504, 1008, 2016.
entries.text: 按 100 厘米顶点间距时取整为 126 米组件的整数倍：504、1008、2016。

entries.source: Make a new landscape from fractal noise at a set size and relief, then read its heights back and capture it from above and at eye level.
entries.text: 用分形噪声按指定尺寸和起伏新建地形，回读高度，并从上方和人眼高度截图。

entries.source: Create a rolling-hills landscape from noise
entries.text: 用噪声创建起伏丘陵地形

entries.source: Lay a main road and a branch between settlement sites with painted verges, place start and goal markers, and prove navmesh routes reach each site.
entries.text: 在聚落之间铺设主路和支路并绘制路边，放置起点与目标标记，证明导航网格路线能到达每个聚落。

entries.source: Connect three settlements with a road network
entries.text: 用道路网连接三个聚落

entries.source: Step a hillside into walkable shelves, paint the shelves as farmland, and measure the step heights along the slope.
entries.text: 把山坡切成可行走的台地，把台面绘制为农田，并沿坡测量台阶高度。

entries.source: Cut farm terraces into a hillside
entries.text: 在山坡上开垦农田梯田

entries.source: Raise an island shelf and peak from a flat sea floor, roughen it, paint sand at the waterline, grass inland and rock on steep slopes, then sample heights.
entries.text: 从平坦海床隆起岛屿台地和山峰并打糙地表，在水线处绘制沙滩、内陆草地和陡坡岩石，再采样高度。

entries.source: Build a tropical island with beaches and cliffs
entries.text: 打造有海滩和悬崖的热带岛屿

entries.source: Measure the gap and height between each pair of selected platforms and flag any the player cannot clear, without changing anything.
entries.text: 测量每对选中平台之间的间隙和高差，标出玩家跳不过去的地方，不做任何修改。

entries.source: Audit jump gaps and ledges against the player's reach
entries.text: 按玩家能力审查跳跃间隙和台沿

entries.source: An octagonal arena with pillars for cover, walkable ramps up to a ring for phase two, checked, played by a bot and captured at eye height.
entries.text: 八角形竞技场，立柱作为掩体，可行走坡道通往第二阶段环道，经过检查、机器人试玩并在视线高度截图。

entries.source: Block out a boss arena with a raised second-phase ring
entries.text: 搭建带第二阶段高台环道的首领竞技场白盒

entries.source: At most 50: one verification case runs at most 55 seconds.
entries.text: 最多 50：单个验证用例最长运行 55 秒。

entries.source: Explore and Reach every goal with the playtest bot, fix stuck spots and falls with ramps, stairs or moves, then play again to prove it.
entries.text: 用试玩机器人探索并到达每个目标，用坡道、楼梯或移动修复卡点和坠落点，然后再跑一遍来证明。

entries.source: Let a bot explore the blockout and fix where it sticks
entries.text: 让机器人探索白盒并修复卡住的地方

entries.source: Flatten a pad on the selected landscape, set blockout pieces at the real ground height, and prove nothing floats or sinks.
entries.text: 在选中的地形上整平一块场地，把白盒部件放在真实地面高度上，并证明没有悬空或陷入地面。

entries.source: Block out a camp on uneven landscape ground
entries.text: 在起伏地形上搭建营地白盒

entries.source: Overlap-test each spawn and doorway with the player's capsule, then move the props that block them to the nearest clear spot in one undo step.
entries.text: 用玩家胶囊体对每个出生点和门洞做重叠检测，在一个撤销步骤中把挡路的道具移到最近的空位。

entries.source: Move props out of blocked spawns and doorways
entries.text: 把堵住出生点和门洞的道具移开

entries.source: Find spawns with long open sightlines, search clear ground along them, and add high cover that cuts them at eye height.
entries.text: 找出出生点的过长开阔视线，沿线搜索空地，加入在视线高度阻断视线的高掩体。

entries.source: Break open sightlines with cover placed in clear spots
entries.text: 在空旷处放置掩体以阻断开阔视线

entries.source: Two bases with flag objectives, a mid-field deck on walkable ramps, mirror-checked across Y and proven by a bot run to each flag.
entries.text: 两座带旗帜目标的基地、经可行走坡道登上的中场平台，按 Y 轴做镜像检查，并由机器人跑到每面旗帜来证明。

entries.source: Block out a capture-the-flag map mirrored across Y = 0
entries.text: 搭建关于 Y = 0 镜像的夺旗地图白盒
小型阴影投射体半径（厘米）

entries.source: Find small shadow casters with the cost report, switch their shadows off in one lighting plan, and prove the drop with numbers and captures.
entries.text: 用开销报告找出小型阴影投射体，在光照计划中关闭它们的阴影，并用数据和截图证明开销下降。

entries.source: Cut shadow cost from small props in an area
entries.text: 削减区域内小道具的阴影开销

entries.source: A hex colour painted into the models' vertex colour.
entries.text: 写入模型顶点色的十六进制颜色。

entries.source: Model rocks, stones and pillars sized to the blockout's cover and pillar blocks, place them where the blocks stood, and recheck cover and routes.
entries.text: 按白盒掩体块和立柱块的尺寸建模岩石、立石和立柱，放到原来方块的位置，再重新检查掩体和路线。

entries.source: Swap grey-box cover for modeled rocks and pillars
entries.text: 把白盒掩体换成建模的岩石和立柱

entries.source: Measure how far each selected actor floats, drop them all onto the surface in one undo step, tilted to slopes up to a limit.
entries.text: 测量每个选中 Actor 悬空的高度，在一个撤销步骤中把它们全部落到表面上，并按坡度倾斜到上限为止。

entries.source: Drop floating props onto the ground below them
entries.text: 把悬空道具落到下方地面上

entries.source: Capture the view from each start at eye height toward its goal plus a top-down plan, and list what reads poorly, without changing anything.
entries.text: 从每个起点以视线高度朝目标截图并加一张俯视平面图，列出不易读懂的地方，不做任何修改。

entries.source: Review a blockout from the player's eye height
entries.text: 从玩家视线高度审查白盒

entries.source: Five rooms joined by 300 cm corridors with one loop, player-scale doorways, a key pickup and an exit goal, every one reachable.
entries.text: 五个房间由 300 厘米宽的走廊相连，含一条环路、玩家尺度的门洞、钥匙拾取物和出口目标，且全部可达。

entries.source: Block out a five-room dungeon with a loop and a key room
entries.text: 搭建带环路和钥匙房的五房间地牢白盒

entries.source: Run the layout checks, then change only the flagged pieces with moves, rebuilds and deletes until errors reach zero, in a few rounds.
entries.text: 运行布局检查，只对被标记的部件做移动、重建和删除，经过几轮直到错误为零。

entries.source: Fix every issue the blockout validator reports
entries.text: 修复白盒校验器报告的全部问题

entries.source: Narrow corridors that turn every 12 m, scare spawns past each corner and no long view ahead, checked against the player's metrics.
entries.text: 狭窄走廊每 12 米转折一次，拐角后设置惊吓出生点，看不到远处，并按玩家尺寸检查。

entries.source: Block out a horror corridor loop that breaks sightlines
entries.text: 搭建阻断视线的恐怖走廊环路白盒

entries.source: A pawn class path such as /Game/Characters/BP_Hero.BP_Hero_C; leave as is for the game mode's default pawn.
entries.text: Pawn 类路径，例如 /Game/Characters/BP_Hero.BP_Hero_C；保持不变则使用游戏模式的默认 Pawn。

entries.source: Read the pawn's height, step, jump and speeds, derive door, corridor, cover and gap sizes, and save them as a project convention.
entries.text: 读取角色的身高、台阶、跳跃和速度，推导门、走廊、掩体和间隙尺寸，并保存为项目约定。

entries.source: Measure the player and save blockout metrics
entries.text: 测量玩家并保存白盒尺寸规范

entries.source: Three lanes, spawns at both ends and low and high cover mirrored across X = 0, then symmetry, sightline and route checks.
entries.text: 三条通道、两端出生点、关于 X = 0 镜像的高低掩体，然后检查对称性、视线和路线。

entries.source: Block out a mirrored three-lane arena for team deathmatch
entries.text: 搭建沿 X 轴镜像的三线团队死斗竞技场白盒

entries.source: A corridor ring 300 cm wide, meeting rooms with doors, cubicle rows as low cover and ceilings over everything, checked against the player's metrics.
entries.text: 300 厘米宽的环形走廊、带门的会议室、作为低掩体的工位排和覆盖全层的天花板，并按玩家尺寸检查。

entries.source: Block out an office floor for close-quarters combat
entries.text: 搭建用于近距离战斗的办公楼层白盒

entries.source: The pawn class path the level must now fit.
entries.text: 关卡现在需要适配的 Pawn 类路径。

entries.source: Measure a new pawn, find blockout openings and ceilings now too tight for it, and rebuild only those pieces to fit.
entries.text: 测量新角色，找出对它来说过窄的门洞和过低的天花板，只重建这些部件。

entries.source: Refit doors and corridors to a bigger player character
entries.text: 按更大的玩家角色调整门洞和走廊
非 Nanite 三角形预算

entries.source: Draw calls, triangles, shadow casters, lights, translucency and the heaviest actors and meshes, checked against your budgets.
entries.text: 统计绘制调用、三角形、阴影投射体、灯光、半透明以及最重的 Actor 和网格体，并对照你的预算检查。

entries.source: Report what the open level costs to render
entries.text: 报告当前关卡的渲染开销

entries.source: Rooftops at varied heights with jump gaps, a fire-escape stair and a ramp, every gap measured against the player's reach and played by a bot.
entries.text: 高度错落的屋顶、跳跃间隙、消防楼梯和坡道，每个间隙都按玩家能力测量，并由机器人实际跑一遍。

entries.source: Block out a rooftop parkour run across city blocks
entries.text: 搭建跨越城市街区的屋顶跑酷路线白盒

entries.source: A floor, walls with a doorway and a corridor sized from the player's metrics, with start and goal markers, then routes and Map Check.
entries.text: 按玩家尺寸生成地面、带门洞的墙和走廊，放置起点与终点标记，然后检查路线和地图检查。

entries.source: Block out a room, doorway and corridor at player scale
entries.text: 按玩家尺寸搭建房间、门洞和走廊白盒

entries.source: At most 60 cm for each gap between islands: 350 suits 8 islands.
entries.text: 每个岛间间隙最多 60 厘米：8 个浮岛适合 350。

entries.source: Island platforms spaced inside SafeJumpGap and stepped under JumpHeight up to a shrine, proven by a bot that plays the route.
entries.text: 浮岛平台的间距不超过 SafeJumpGap、高差低于 JumpHeight，一路通向神殿，并由机器人实际跑通路线来证明。

entries.source: Block out floating sky-island jumps for a platformer
entries.text: 为平台跳跃游戏搭建浮空岛跳跃白盒

entries.source: A central hub, four spoke corridors to side rooms, a mezzanine on walkable ramps and pickups in each room, all reachable on the navmesh.
entries.text: 中央枢纽、通往侧室的四条辐射走廊、经可行走坡道到达的夹层，每个房间都有拾取物，且都能在导航网格上到达。

entries.source: Block out a sci-fi station hub with spokes and a mezzanine
entries.text: 搭建带辐射走廊和夹层的科幻空间站枢纽白盒

entries.source: A walled courtyard with staggered high cover, guard posts and a hidden objective, checked for exposed cover, sightlines and reachability.
entries.text: 带围墙的庭院，交错的高掩体、守卫岗哨和隐蔽目标，并检查暴露掩体、视线和可达性。

entries.source: Block out a stealth courtyard with guard posts and cover
entries.text: 搭建带守卫岗哨和掩体的潜行庭院白盒

entries.source: Storeys joined by stairs split to the player's step height, ceilings checked against the player, and a bot that climbs from the door to the roof.
entries.text: 各层之间的楼梯按玩家台阶高度拆分，按玩家尺寸检查天花板，并由机器人从门口一路爬到屋顶。

entries.source: Block out a three-storey tower with stairs at step height
entries.text: 搭建按台阶高度分级楼梯的三层塔楼白盒

entries.source: A 40 m street between false-front buildings with doorways, porch steps, crates for low cover, spawns at both ends and a saloon objective.
entries.text: 40 米长的街道两侧是带门洞的假立面建筑，有门廊台阶、作为低掩体的木箱、两端出生点和酒馆目标。

entries.source: Block out a western main street for a showdown
entries.text: 搭建西部小镇主街决斗场景白盒

entries.source: The view to judge; the level viewport is used if no camera has this label
entries.text: 要评估的视角；若没有此标签的摄像机，则使用关卡视口

entries.source: Read the sun, sky, fog, post process, local lights and renderer settings, capture the view, and score it against the lighting-artist bar.
entries.text: 读取太阳、天空、雾、后期处理、局部光源和渲染设置，截取画面，并按灯光师的标准打分。

entries.source: Audit the level's lighting before you change it
entries.text: 修改前先审计关卡光照

entries.source: The view to judge; the level viewport is used if no camera has this label
entries.text: 要评估的视角；若没有此标签的摄像机，则使用关卡视口

entries.source: Stop the selected blockout shapes that stand in for leaves, cloth or glass from casting solid shadows, and show the before and after.
entries.text: 让所选代替树叶、布料或玻璃的白模形体不再投射实心阴影，并展示修改前后的对比。

entries.source: Let light through blockout foliage and glass
entries.text: 让白模植被和玻璃透光

entries.source: About 15 noon sun, 12 overcast, 8 bright interior, 4 dim interior, -2 moonlight

entries.text: 用岩石配方制作三块风化巨石

entries.text: 按顺序列出所选对象的修改器及其状态、属性动画器，并验证修改器堆栈。

entries.text: 为性能测试停用高开销几何修改器

始终相关的 Actor 蓝图

entries.source: Make the selected inventory actors owner-relevant and an objective actor always relevant, validate ownership, and check what each client receives.
entries.text: 让所选背包类 Actor 仅对拥有者相关、目标 Actor 始终相关，验证所有权，并检查每个客户端实际收到的内容。

entries.source: Make inventory actors relevant only to their owner
entries.text: 让背包类 Actor 只与其拥有者相关

entries.source: Label or class name of a placed instance; walking to it changes the state
entries.text: 已放置实例的标签或类名；走到它旁边会改变状态

entries.source: Turn on replication for the selected actor Blueprint and its state variable, then play a listen server with two players and check the client sees it.
entries.text: 为所选 Actor 蓝图及其状态变量开启复制，然后以两名玩家运行监听服务器，检查客户端能看到状态变化。

entries.source: Make an actor replicate its state and prove clients see it
entries.text: 让 Actor 复制其状态并证明客户端可见

entries.source: Generated class path of the pawn the game mode spawns
entries.text: 游戏模式生成的 Pawn 的生成类路径

entries.source: Create game mode, game state, player controller, player state and HUD Blueprints, wire them together, use them in this level, and prove it in play.
entries.text: 创建游戏模式、游戏状态、玩家控制器、玩家状态和 HUD 蓝图，把它们串联起来用于当前关卡，并在运行中验证。

entries.source: Set up a game mode with its framework classes
entries.text: 搭建游戏模式及其框架类

entries.source: Add a reliable Server fire RPC and an unreliable Multicast effects RPC, replicate ammo to the owner, and prove a client's shot reaches the server.
entries.text: 添加可靠的 Server 开火 RPC 和不可靠的 Multicast 特效 RPC，将弹药仅复制给拥有者，并证明客户端的射击能到达服务器。

entries.source: Add server and multicast RPCs to a weapon Blueprint
entries.text: 为武器蓝图添加 Server 与 Multicast RPC
最多修改的翻页动画数

entries.source: Find the flipbooks under a folder and retime each one that differs to a shared frame rate, one validated edit per asset.
entries.text: 找出文件夹下的翻页动画，把帧率不同的逐个改成统一帧率，每个资产一次经过验证的修改。

entries.source: Set one frame rate for every flipbook in a folder
entries.text: 为文件夹中所有翻页动画统一帧率

entries.source: Find the sprites, flipbooks, tile sets and tile maps under a folder, validate each one, and rank what to fix first.
entries.text: 找出文件夹下的精灵、翻页动画、图块集和图块地图，逐个验证，并按优先级排出待修项。

entries.source: Audit every Paper2D asset in a folder
entries.text: 审查文件夹中的所有 Paper2D 资产

entries.source: Set a flipbook's frames per second so one loop lasts exactly the time you need, then validate it and confirm the new length.
entries.text: 设置翻页动画的每秒帧数，使一次循环恰好持续所需时间，然后验证并确认新时长。

entries.source: Retime a flipbook to an exact duration
entries.text: 把翻页动画调整到精确时长

entries.source: Give a tile map 3D collision with a set thickness, validate it, and prove in play that the player stands on it.
entries.text: 为图块地图设置带厚度的 3D 碰撞，验证后在运行中证明玩家能站在上面。

entries.source: Make a tile map's platforms solid for the player
entries.text: 让图块地图的平台对玩家变为实体

entries.source: Read a sprite's pixels per unit, collision and material, validate it for authoring, and list what to fix in the Sprite Editor.
entries.text: 读取精灵的每单位像素数、碰撞和材质，按制作就绪标准验证，并列出需在精灵编辑器中修正的项。

entries.source: Check a sprite is ready for the game
entries.text: 检查精灵能否用于游戏

entries.source: List a tile map's layers with size, collision and visibility, and validate it for authoring, without changing anything.
entries.text: 列出图块地图各图层的尺寸、碰撞和可见性，并按制作就绪标准验证，不做任何修改。

entries.source: Review a tile map's layers before it ships
entries.text: 发布前审查图块地图的图层

entries.source: Set tile size, spacing and drawing offset on a tile set so its grid lines up with the sheet, then check the tile count.
entries.text: 设置图块集的图块尺寸、间距和绘制偏移，使网格与图集对齐，然后核对图块数量。

entries.source: Fix a tile set's grid to match its sprite sheet
entries.text: 修正图块集网格以对齐精灵图集

entries.source: Add one species to a biome of an ecosystem in its big-to-small place, regrow it, and prove the species before it kept their exact counts.
entries.text: 按从大到小的顺序把一个新物种加入生态系统的生物群落，重新生成，并证明排在它之前的物种数量完全不变。

entries.source: Add an understorey species to an existing ecosystem
entries.text: 为现有生态系统添加林下物种

entries.source: Stack forest, dwarf-pine scrub and scree biomes by height on a mountain landscape so the treeline reads clearly, then verify each band.
entries.text: 在山地地形上按高度叠放森林、矮松灌丛和碎石坡生物群落，使林线清晰可辨，然后逐带验证。

entries.source: Grow a mountain treeline with scree above it
entries.text: 培育上方为碎石坡的高山林线

entries.source: List every PCG volume with its graph, size and instance count, read each graph's recipes, check graphs for structural issues, and change nothing.
entries.text: 列出每个 PCG 体积及其图表、尺寸和实例数，读取各图表的配方，检查结构问题，不做任何修改。

entries.source: Audit the level's PCG volumes and graphs
entries.text: 审查关卡中的 PCG 体积和图表

entries.source: Remove what the selected PCG volumes generated after a dry run, keeping their graphs and volumes, then prove each volume is empty.
entries.text: 试运行后移除所选 PCG 体积生成的实例，保留其图表和体积，然后证明每个体积都已清空。

entries.source: Clear generated PCG from selected volumes
entries.text: 清除所选体积中已生成的 PCG

entries.source: Grow a sparse western desert on sand: saguaros, half-buried boulders, creosote clumps and dry grass drifts, with long open sightlines.
entries.text: 在沙地上培育稀疏的西部荒漠：巨柱仙人掌、半埋巨石、灌木丛和成片干草，保留开阔的远眺视线。

entries.source: Dress a desert scrubland with cacti and boulders
entries.text: 用仙人掌和巨石装点沙漠灌木地

entries.source: Points on the road's centreline to test; the Points of its landscape.road op work.
entries.text: 道路中心线上要检测的点；可直接用 landscape.road 操作的 Points。

entries.source: Make an ecosystem avoid the road layer and keep a margin from the landscape's roads, regenerate, and prove the roads are clear with downward traces.
entries.text: 让生态系统避开道路图层并与地形道路的路面边缘保持间距，重新生成后用向下射线检测证明道路畅通。

entries.source: Keep roads open through a PCG forest
entries.text: 让道路穿过 PCG 森林时保持畅通

entries.source: Grow grass and wildflower drifts on a meadow layer inside a sized PCG volume, so flowers gather in patches instead of an even sprinkle.
entries.text: 在设定大小的 PCG 体积内，用双物种生态系统在草甸图层上培育草地和成片野花，让花朵聚成斑块而非均匀铺满。

entries.source: Sow a wildflower meadow in drifts
Erase every foliage instance in set circles after a dry run so routes, doorways and cover stay open, then prove each spot is empty.
entries.text: 试运行后清除指定圆形区域内的所有植被实例，让路线、门口和掩体保持畅通，再逐点证明已清空。

entries.source: Clear foliage from paths, doorways and cover spots
entries.text: 清除小路、门口和掩体点的植被

entries.source: Make pine and rock foliage types from meshes, scatter them over a landscape off steep ground and roads, keep a camp clear, and count them.
entries.text: 用网格创建松树和岩石植被类型，散布到地形上并避开陡坡和道路，保持营地空地，然后统计数量。

entries.source: Scatter a pine forest with foliage types
entries.text: 用植被类型散布一片松林

entries.source: Mesh if the type is new
Drop one foliage type onto chosen points as hero trees, each landing on the ground below, and confirm every one stands where asked.
entries.text: 把一种植被类型放到指定点上作为标志性树木，每棵都落在下方地面上，并确认每棵都在所要求的位置。

entries.source: Place hero trees at exact points
entries.text: 在精确位置放置标志性树木

entries.source: Scatter moss and trailing ivy onto the upward faces of a ruin's static meshes, under arches too, aligned to the surface, and count what took.
entries.text: 把苔藓和垂挂常春藤散布到废墟静态网格朝上的面上（拱门下方也包括在内）并贴合表面，然后统计生成数量。

entries.source: Grow moss and ivy over ruin tops and ledges
entries.text: 让苔藓和常春藤长满废墟顶部和边沿

entries.source: Measure foliage shadow cost, give each type a cull distance by size and turn off small types' shadows, then measure again against a shadow budget.
entries.text: 测量植被阴影开销，按尺寸为每种类型设置剔除距离并关闭小型植被的阴影，然后对照阴影预算再次测量。

entries.source: Cut foliage cost with cull distances and shadows
entries.text: 通过剔除距离和阴影降低植被开销

entries.source: Take the selected foliage types and all their instances out of the level after a dry run, leaving the type assets on disk.
entries.text: 试运行后从关卡中移除所选植被类型及其所有实例，保留磁盘上的类型资产。

entries.source: Remove a foliage type from the level
entries.text: 从关卡中移除植被类型
类型 -> 网格对应关系

entries.source: Point the selected foliage types at their final meshes so every placed instance keeps its spot, and check counts stay identical.
entries.text: 把所选植被类型指向最终网格，使每个已放置实例保持原位，并检查数量保持一致。

entries.source: Swap placeholder foliage meshes for final art
entries.text: 将占位植被网格替换为最终美术资源

entries.source: Remove a share of the foliage instances in a circle at random after a dry run, keep the rest, and prove nothing outside the circle changed.
entries.text: 试运行后随机移除圆形区域内一定比例的植被实例，保留其余部分，并证明圆外没有任何变化。

entries.source: Thin overgrown foliage around a point by half
entries.text: 将某点周围过密的植被减半

entries.source: Build a PCG ecosystem of pines, bush clumps, rocks and ferns on one landscape layer, generate it, and prove density, stands and culling.
entries.text: 在一个地形图层上用 PCG 生态系统培育松树、灌木丛、岩石和蕨类，生成后验证密度、林分和剔除距离。

entries.source: Grow a layered pine forest on a paint layer
entries.text: 在绘制图层上培育分层松林

entries.source: Grow a fantasy swamp on a mud layer: dead trees, sunken logs, reed clumps and mushroom rings, with shore reeds and the path kept clear.
entries.text: 在泥地图层上培育奇幻沼泽：枯树、半埋原木、芦苇丛和蘑菇圈，岸边长芦苇，小路保持畅通。

entries.source: Grow a haunted swamp of dead trees and reeds
entries.text: 培育长满枯树和芦苇的闹鬼沼泽

entries.source: Make an ecosystem keep a set margin around actors with a tag, regenerate, and prove no plant stands in any building's clearance.
entries.text: 让生态系统在带指定标签的 Actor 周围保留设定间距，重新生成，并证明没有植物位于任何建筑的净空范围内。

entries.source: Keep PCG growth clear of tagged buildings
entries.text: 让 PCG 植被避开带标签的建筑

entries.source: An image file inside the project, such as a generated reference, concept art or a photo.
entries.text: 项目内的图像文件，例如生成的参考图、概念图或照片。

entries.source: Frame a view like the reference, grow an ecosystem, then retune species round by round until the image score reaches the target.
entries.text: 按参考图构图取景，培育生态系统，然后逐轮调整物种，直到图像评分达到目标。

entries.source: Grow a forest that matches a reference image
entries.text: 培育与参考图相符的森林

entries.source: Paint woodland and heath layers as a patch mosaic, grow a two-biome PCG ecosystem on them, and prove each grows only on its own layer.
entries.text: 以斑块镶嵌方式绘制林地和荒原图层，培育对应的双生物群落 PCG 生态系统，并证明各自只生长在自己的图层上。

entries.source: Paint biome layers and grow an ecosystem on each
entries.text: 绘制生物群落图层并分别培育生态系统

entries.source: Grow a two-biome ecosystem in World Partition cells, read how far each species samples past its cell, and check cell edges for seams.
entries.text: 在世界分区单元中生成双生物群落生态系统，读取各物种越过单元采样的距离，并检查单元边缘有无接缝。

entries.source: Grow a seamless ecosystem across World Partition cells
entries.text: 跨世界分区单元生成无接缝生态系统

entries.source: Validate the selected PCG component as generation-ready, run generate_validate_cleanup through a dry run and the real job, and report the end state.
entries.text: 验证所选 PCG 组件已可生成，经试运行和正式任务执行 generate_validate_cleanup，并报告最终状态。

entries.source: Prove a PCG volume generates cleanly and leaves nothing
entries.text: 证明 PCG 体积能干净生成且不留残余
关注点（节点、网格或 all）

entries.source: Explain how the selected PCG graph builds its result: each spawner's node chain, meshes, cull distances and parameters, plus structural health.
entries.text: 解释所选 PCG 图表如何生成结果：每个生成器的节点链、网格、剔除距离和参数，以及结构健康状况。

entries.source: Read a marketplace PCG graph as recipes
entries.text: 把市场上的 PCG 图表读成配方

entries.source: Generate the selected PCG component through a sealed plan, keep the result, and report what it produced with before and after captures.
entries.text: 通过密封计划生成所选 PCG 组件并保留结果，用前后截图报告生成了什么。

entries.source: Regenerate a PCG volume and keep its output
entries.text: 重新生成 PCG 体积并保留输出

entries.source: Read an ecosystem graph's op, change one species' density, footprint or cull distance, rebuild with ecosystem.set, and compare counts.
entries.text: 读取生态系统图表的操作，修改一个物种的密度、占地或剔除距离，用 ecosystem.set 重建并对比数量。

entries.source: Retune one species in an ecosystem and regrow it
entries.text: 调整生态系统中的单个物种并重新生长
新密度（每平方米，0 表示保持）
新网格（资产路径，或 keep）

entries.source: Change a tool-made scatter graph's meshes, density or seed with graph.set, regenerate its volume, and compare counts and looks before and after.
entries.text: 用 graph.set 修改工具生成的散布图表的网格、密度或种子，重新生成其体积，并对比前后的数量和外观。

entries.source: Swap meshes and reseed a PCG scatter
entries.text: 为 PCG 散布更换网格并重设种子

entries.source: Build a one-layer PCG scatter of the selected rock meshes, kept off cliffs and spaced apart, in a volume you size, then count what grew.
entries.text: 用所选岩石网格构建单层 PCG 散布，避开陡崖并保持间距，放入你设定大小的体积中，然后统计生成数量。

entries.source: Scatter weighted rocks over a hillside with PCG
entries.text: 用 PCG 在山坡上按权重散布岩石

entries.source: Grow a sci-fi ecosystem on an ash layer: tilted crystal spires, crystal clusters, shard debris and alien moss, with slope limits and culling.
entries.text: 在灰烬图层上培育科幻生态系统：倾斜的水晶尖塔、水晶簇、碎片和外星苔藓，带坡度限制和剔除距离。

entries.source: Grow an alien crystal field on ash plains
entries.text: 在灰烬平原上培育外星水晶田

entries.source: Bodies with more shapes than this are listed for a designer to simplify.
entries.text: 形状数超过此值的刚体会被列出，供设计师简化。

entries.source: Read every body, shape, constraint and disabled collision pair of the selected Physics Asset and report structural problems. Changes nothing.
entries.text: 读取所选物理资产的每个刚体、形状、约束和禁用碰撞对，并报告结构问题。不做任何修改。

entries.source: Audit a physics asset's bodies and constraints
entries.text: 审计物理资产的刚体和约束

entries.source: Swap the boxes and hulls on a quadruped's leg and tail bodies for one named capsule each, sized from the old shape, and prove the swap.
entries.text: 把四足生物腿部和尾部刚体上的盒体与凸包替换为各一个命名胶囊体，按旧形状确定尺寸，并证明替换结果。

entries.source: Replace a creature's limb shapes with clean capsules
entries.text: 把生物肢体形状换成干净的胶囊体

entries.source: Dry-run new solver iterations, a collision profile and a simulate flag against the selected Physics Asset and report exactly what would change.
entries.text: 针对所选物理资产试运行新的求解器迭代次数、碰撞预设和模拟开关设置，准确报告将会发生的改动。

entries.source: Preflight a physics solver and collision change
entries.text: 预检物理求解器和碰撞设置的修改

entries.source: Create a Physics Asset from the selected Skeletal Mesh, make sure every key bone has a body and a joint, and validate it.
entries.text: 从所选骨骼网格体创建物理资产，确保每根关键骨骼都有刚体和关节，并进行验证。

entries.source: Generate a ragdoll physics asset from a mesh
entries.text: 从网格生成布娃娃物理资产

entries.source: Make an enemy Blueprint drop into a simulated ragdoll when its health reaches zero, then defeat it in play and record the fall.
entries.text: 让敌人蓝图在生命值归零时切换为模拟布娃娃，然后在游戏中击败它并录制倒下的过程。

entries.source: Ragdoll an enemy on death and prove it in play
entries.text: 让敌人死亡时变成布娃娃并在游戏中证明

entries.source: Check each selected Skeletal Mesh has the skeleton and bones a Physics Asset needs, assign it to the ones that fit, and read every assignment back.
entries.text: 检查每个所选骨骼网格体是否具备物理资产所需的骨架和骨骼，为符合条件的网格指定该资产，并逐一读回确认。

entries.source: Share one physics asset across mesh variants
entries.text: 让多个网格变体共用一个物理资产

entries.source: Set a dragon's tail bodies to Simulated with lighter mass and soft limits, keep the rest animated, and prove each body's mode and limit.
entries.text: 把巨龙尾部刚体设为模拟、减轻质量并设置柔和的限制，其余部分继续由动画驱动，并证明每个刚体的模式和限制。

entries.source: Let a creature's tail swing while its body animates
entries.text: 让生物尾巴随物理摆动而身体保持动画

entries.source: bone swing1/swing2/twist in degrees; _l and _r share a row; 0 locks that motion.
entries.text: 骨骼 swing1/swing2/twist，单位为度；_l 与 _r 共用一行；0 表示锁定该运动。

entries.source: Apply a table of swing and twist limits to neck, spine, shoulders, elbows, hips and knees, then read every limit back to within half a degree.
entries.text: 按表为颈部、脊柱、肩、肘、髋和膝设置摆动与扭转限制，然后读回每个限制，误差不超过半度。

entries.source: Set believable joint limits on a humanoid ragdoll
entries.text: 为人形布娃娃设置合理的关节限制

entries.source: Each requirement one observable thing, separated by semicolons
entries.text: 每条需求描述一个可观察的结果，用分号分隔

entries.source: Split acceptance criteria into one bot case each, play them all at once in copies of the level, and judge each from evidence.
entries.text: 把验收标准拆成每条一个机器人用例，在关卡副本中同时运行，并依据证据逐条判定。

entries.source: Verify a feature's requirements in one minute
entries.text: 一分钟内验证功能的全部需求

entries.source: Object path of the enemy's Behavior Tree or AI Controller Blueprint
entries.text: 敌人的行为树或 AI 控制器蓝图的对象路径
行为树或 AI 控制器

entries.source: Prove the enemy closes in once the player is near, and gives up after the player flees out of range.
entries.text: 证明玩家靠近后敌人会逼近追击，玩家逃出范围后敌人会放弃追击。

entries.source: Check an enemy AI chases and then loses the player
entries.text: 检查敌人 AI 会追击并最终丢失玩家

entries.source: Compile the fixed Blueprint, replay the bug's steps in parallel cases, and confirm no new script errors reach the log.
entries.text: 编译已修复的蓝图，并行重放引发缺陷的步骤，并确认日志中没有新的脚本错误。

entries.source: Regression-test a Blueprint fix in play
entries.text: 在游戏中回归测试蓝图修复

entries.source: A tag or class naming every collectible
entries.text: 能指代全部收集物的标记或类名

entries.source: Label, name, tag or class of the goal
entries.text: 终点的标签、名称、标记或类名

entries.source: 0 plays like a new player, 1 like a skilled one
entries.text: 0 像新手，1 像熟练玩家

entries.source: A bot plays like a person to the goal and collects every pickup, writing maps that show where the level blocks a player.
entries.text: 机器人像真人一样前往终点并收集所有拾取物，生成路线图，显示关卡在哪些地方会卡住玩家。

entries.source: Check a level can be finished from start to goal
entries.text: 检查关卡能否从起点通关到终点

entries.source: A tag or class naming every enemy in the encounter
entries.text: 能指代遭遇战中所有敌人的标记或类名

entries.source: Property path the bot reads health from
entries.text: 机器人读取生命值的属性路径
新手至少胜场（共 3 场）

entries.source: Bots at two skill levels fight the encounter; compare wins, accuracy, damage and health left against your targets.
entries.text: 两种水平的机器人分别挑战遭遇战，将胜场、命中率、伤害和剩余生命值与你的目标对比。

entries.source: Playtest a combat encounter as new and skilled players
entries.text: 以新手和老手身份试玩战斗遭遇

entries.source: Label, name, tag or class of the door
entries.text: 门的标签、名称、标记或类名

entries.source: The Blueprint variable that is true when the door is open
entries.text: 门打开时为 true 的蓝图变量

entries.source: Walk to a door, interact, and prove its open flag flips in time, recorded as an MP4 with each step drawn over the game.
entries.text: 走到门前并交互，证明其开启标志按时切换，并录制叠加了每个步骤结果的 MP4 视频。

entries.source: Check a door opens when the player walks up
entries.text: 检查玩家走近时门会打开

entries.source: Host and client play in one editor; the host opens the door, and checks on the client and a late joiner prove it replicated.
entries.text: 主机与客户端在同一编辑器中游玩；主机开门，再在客户端和中途加入的玩家上检查，证明状态已同步。

entries.source: Test a door replicates to clients and late joiners
entries.text: 测试门的状态同步到客户端和中途加入者
每个机器人探索的秒数

entries.source: Several bots explore the level at once; merge their maps into a list of stuck spots and falls so you know where to fix collision.
entries.text: 多个机器人同时探索关卡，合并其路线图，列出卡住点和坠落点，便于定位需要修复碰撞的位置。

entries.source: Find where players get stuck or fall out
entries.text: 找出玩家会卡住或掉出世界的位置

entries.source: Exactly what the widget reads at full health
entries.text: 满血时控件显示的确切文字

entries.source: UserWidget.WidgetName of the text that shows health
entries.text: 显示生命值的文本控件，格式为 UserWidget.控件名

entries.source: Walk into a hazard, confirm health drops, and check the HUD widget's text changes on screen, with captures before and after.
entries.text: 走进危险区域，确认生命值下降，并检查 HUD 控件的文字在屏幕上随之变化，附前后截图。

entries.source: Prove the HUD shows damage when the player is hurt
entries.text: 验证玩家受伤时 HUD 显示伤害

entries.source: Click menu buttons through Slate in Play In Editor, assert the screen each opens and that Back returns, capturing every screen.
entries.text: 在编辑器内运行时通过 Slate 点击菜单按钮，断言每个按钮打开的界面以及返回按钮能回到原处，并截取每个界面。

entries.source: Click through a menu and check each screen opens
entries.text: 逐个点击菜单并检查每个界面能打开

entries.source: A number, or pawn to use the pawn's WalkSpeed
entries.text: 填写数值，或填 pawn 使用角色的 WalkSpeed

entries.source: Hold the move input, sample the speed, release, and jump; compare walk speed and stopping with the pawn's settings or your targets.
entries.text: 按住移动输入并采样速度，再松开和跳跃；将行走速度和停步表现与角色设置或你的目标对比。

entries.source: Measure walk speed, stopping and jump against targets
entries.text: 按目标测量行走速度、停步和跳跃

entries.source: Label, name, tag or class of the pickup
entries.text: 拾取物的标签、名称、标记或类名

entries.source: PlayerState, GameState, GameMode or an actor label
entries.text: PlayerState、GameState、GameMode 或某个 Actor 标签

entries.source: Walk the bot to a pickup, check it vanishes and the score rises by the right amount, with a screenshot as proof.
entries.text: 让机器人走到拾取物处，检查它是否消失、分数是否按正确数值增加，并附截图作为证据。

entries.source: Prove a pickup adds score and disappears
entries.text: 验证拾取物会加分并消失

entries.source: Two local bots duel at different skill levels across several seeds; report who wins, accuracy and time to kill.
entries.text: 两个本地机器人以不同水平在多个随机种子下对决，报告胜负、命中率和击杀用时。

entries.source: Balance-check a 1v1 duel with two bot players
entries.text: 用两个机器人玩家检查 1v1 对决平衡

entries.source: Label, name or class of the NPC to talk to
entries.text: 需要对话的 NPC 的标签、名称或类名

entries.source: Play a short scripted path through one quest step and save an MP4 with every step's result drawn on it, plus a timeline.
entries.text: 按脚本完成一个任务步骤，保存叠加了每步结果的 MP4 视频及时间线文件。

entries.source: Record a reviewable video of a quest step
entries.text: 录制任务步骤的可审阅视频

entries.source: An actor label, name, tag or class the player should reach
entries.text: 玩家应到达的 Actor 标签、名称、标记或类名

entries.source: Learn the player start, actor classes, controls and whether a target is reachable, so later tests name real things.
entries.text: 了解玩家出生点、Actor 类、操作按键以及目标是否可达，让后续测试使用真实存在的名称。

entries.source: Survey the level before writing playtests
entries.text: 编写试玩测试前先勘察关卡

entries.source: Whether the lore command is installed, if the project's Lore repository is local or on a server, who is signed in, and what to do next.
entries.text: lore 命令是否已安装、项目的 Lore 仓库在本机还是在服务器上、当前登录身份，以及下一步该做什么。

entries.source: Check this project's Lore version control
entries.text: 检查本项目的 Lore 版本控制

entries.source: The corrected fact, or remove it
entries.text: 更正后的事实，或填 remove it 表示删除

entries.source: Find a stale note an agent saved, replace it with the corrected fact or forget it, and prove recall now returns the right one.
entries.text: 找到智能体保存的过时条目，用更正后的事实替换或将其删除，并证明回顾时返回的是正确内容。

entries.source: Correct or remove a wrong project memory note
entries.text: 更正或删除错误的项目记忆条目

entries.source: A word or two that names it in code and assets
entries.text: 在代码和资产中称呼该功能的一两个词

entries.source: Search the project's C++ symbols and assets for a feature, check the index is fresh, and list the files to read first.
entries.text: 在项目的 C++ 符号和资产中搜索某个功能，确认索引是最新的，并列出应先阅读的文件。

entries.source: Find where a feature lives in code and content
entries.text: 查找某个功能在代码和内容中的位置
以逗号分隔的确切变量名

entries.source: One batched read lists each loaded instance of a class with its location and properties, flags stacked copies and finds its source.
entries.text: 一次批量读取列出某个类每个已加载实例的位置和属性，标出叠放的重复副本，并找到该类的源码或资产。

entries.source: Inventory every placed actor of one class
entries.text: 盘点关卡中某个类的全部已放置 Actor

entries.source: Pull the project's conventions, gotchas, past tasks and recent agent changes about an area before anyone edits it.
entries.text: 在动手修改前，调出项目中关于该领域的约定、陷阱、过往任务和近期智能体改动。

entries.source: Recall what the project knows before a task
entries.text: 开始任务前回顾项目已有的知识

entries.source: Project-relative paths, comma separated, or all for every file agents changed
entries.text: 以逗号分隔的项目相对路径，或填 all 表示智能体改动的全部文件

entries.source: List files agents checked out or added, check for unsaved and sandboxed work, dry-run the submit, then submit once you approve.
entries.text: 列出智能体签出或新增的文件，检查未保存和沙盒中的内容，先试运行提交，经你批准后再正式提交。

entries.source: Review and submit what agents changed
entries.text: 审阅并提交智能体的改动

entries.source: Check memory for an existing note, then save one clear convention every future chat will follow, and confirm it reads back.
entries.text: 先检查记忆中是否已有相关条目，再保存一条以后每次对话都会遵循的明确约定，并确认能读取回来。

entries.source: Save a team convention to project memory
entries.text: 把团队约定保存到项目记忆

entries.source: Exact variable names, comma separated, such as Health or bIsOpen
entries.text: 以逗号分隔的确切变量名，如 Health 或 bIsOpen

entries.source: Capture the selection's labels, classes, transforms, components and chosen properties, then re-validate them for a bug report or handoff.
entries.text: 记录所选 Actor 的标签、类、变换、组件和指定属性，再重新校验，用于缺陷报告或交接。

entries.source: Snapshot and validate the selected actors
entries.text: 为选中的 Actor 拍快照并校验

entries.source: List files agents checked out, locked or added this session, recent agent changes from memory, and the state of an operation.
entries.text: 列出本次会话中智能体签出、锁定或新增的文件、记忆中的近期改动，以及某个操作的状态。

entries.source: See what agents changed and hold right now
entries.text: 查看智能体当前的改动和占用的文件
下个任务需要的工具包

entries.source: Read the capability report and sandbox status to see which packs and tools agents can use in this project, and why others are off.
entries.text: 读取能力报告和沙盒状态，查看智能体在本项目中可使用的工具包和工具，以及其他工具不可用的原因。

entries.source: Check which HyperAI tool packs are live here
entries.text: 检查本项目中哪些 HyperAI 工具包可用

entries.source: The team builds a GAS fireball with a mana cost, cooldown and damage, plus trail and impact effects, then proves it in play.
entries.text: 团队用 GAS 制作带法力消耗、冷却和伤害的火球术，配上拖尾与命中特效，并在游戏中验证。

entries.source: Make a fireball spell: VFX, GAS cost and cooldown
entries.text: 团队制作火球术：特效、GAS 消耗与冷却

entries.source: The lighting artist sets the mood, the cinematographer frames and cuts the shots, and QA checks the cut before a draft render.
entries.text: 灯光师营造氛围，摄影师构图并剪辑镜头，QA 在草稿渲染前检查剪辑质量。

entries.source: Shoot and render a level intro cutscene
entries.text: 团队拍摄并渲染关卡开场过场动画
需要照亮的目标（Actor 标签）

entries.source: The lighting artist lights an existing blockout to a mood with exposure locked, QA measures the captures, and the director signs off.
entries.text: 灯光师在锁定曝光的前提下按氛围为现有白盒布光，QA 测量截图数据，导演最终验收。

entries.source: Give a blockout a lighting pass and a QA check
entries.text: 为白盒关卡完成一次布光并进行 QA 检查

entries.source: The team blocks out a crypt, scripts a key that unlocks its door, lights it with torches, and proves a player gets through.
entries.text: 团队完成墓室白盒、编写用钥匙开门的逻辑、布置火把照明，并证明玩家能够通过。

entries.source: Build a locked crypt room with a key, lit and tested
entries.text: 团队搭建带钥匙的上锁墓室，含灯光与测试

entries.source: Where the player's gold lives, as owner.property
entries.text: 玩家金币所在位置，格式为 所属对象.属性

entries.source: A sparkle effect, an on-screen interact prompt and a chest that pays out gold, built by three roles and proven in play.
entries.text: 由三个角色分别制作闪光特效、屏幕交互提示和发放金币的宝箱，并在游戏中验证。

entries.source: Add a lootable chest with a prompt, sparkle and loot
entries.text: 添加带提示、闪光和战利品的宝箱

entries.source: Path to the concept art PNG
entries.text: 概念图 PNG 的路径

entries.source: The lighting and technical artists work a scored image-match session until the level looks like the reference, then QA checks range.
entries.text: 灯光师和技术美术在评分的图像匹配流程中迭代，直到关卡与参考图一致，再由 QA 检查亮度范围。

entries.source: Relight and resurface a level to match concept art
entries.text: 团队重新布光并调整表面以匹配概念图

entries.source: The team shapes terrain with a flattened camp, lays a road, grows a forest that keeps off it, lights it and proves it is reachable.
entries.text: 团队塑造带平整营地的地形、铺设道路、生成避开道路的森林、布置灯光，并证明营地可以到达。

entries.source: Build an open-world outpost: terrain, road and forest
entries.text: 团队搭建开放世界前哨：地形、道路与森林

entries.source: A mirror-symmetric arena and a server-driven capture point, proven on a listen-server client that sees the capture complete.
entries.text: 搭建镜像对称的竞技场和由服务器驱动的占领点，并在监听服务器的客户端上证明能看到占领完成。

entries.source: Build a replicated capture point in a symmetric arena
entries.text: 在对称竞技场中搭建可同步的占领点

entries.source: Exactly what the ammo text shows at the start
entries.text: 开局时弹药文本显示的确切内容

entries.source: The UI designer lays out a health bar and ammo counter, the programmer binds them to the player, and QA proves they update in play.
entries.text: UI 设计师布局生命条和弹药计数，程序员将其绑定到玩家，QA 证明它们在游戏中会实时更新。

entries.source: Build a sci-fi HUD with health and ammo, wired and tested
entries.text: 团队制作科幻 HUD：生命值与弹药，接线并测试

entries.source: A patrol route, a guard AI that chases on sight and returns to patrol, and parallel bot cases proving each behaviour.
entries.text: 设置巡逻路线和发现玩家即追击、丢失后回到巡逻的守卫 AI，并用并行机器人用例验证每种行为。

entries.source: Add a stealth guard that patrols, chases and gives up
entries.text: 添加会巡逻、追击并放弃的潜行守卫

entries.source: A checkpoint course, a lap-timer HUD and in-order checkpoint logic, proven by a bot that runs the lap and one that skips a gate.
entries.text: 搭建检查点赛道、圈速计时 HUD 和按顺序计数的检查点逻辑，用跑完一圈的机器人和跳过一道门的机器人验证。

entries.source: Build a time-trial course with checkpoints and a timer
entries.text: 搭建带检查点和计时器的计时赛赛道

entries.source: Validate a UAF graph, then wire its output, feed empty pose pins and remove orphan stacks in one dry-run-first plan.
entries.text: 校验 UAF 图表，然后在先试运行的计划中连接输出、补齐空的姿势引脚并删除孤立特征栈。

entries.source: Check and repair a UAF animation graph
entries.text: 检查并修复 UAF 动画图表

entries.source: The smallest useful UAF graph: one sequence player with a set play rate and start offset feeding the output, compiled and allocated.
entries.text: 最小可用的 UAF 图表：一个设定播放速率和起始偏移的序列播放器连到输出，编译并可分配实例。

entries.source: Make a one-stack UAF idle loop for crowd NPCs
entries.text: 为人群 NPC 制作单特征栈 UAF 待机循环

entries.source: 1D on Speed, or 2D with Speed on one axis like the template's BS_Idle_Walk_Run.
entries.text: 以 Speed 为轴的一维混合空间，或像模板中 BS_Idle_Walk_Run 那样有一个 Speed 轴的二维混合空间。

entries.source: The UAF Cookbook's starter graph: idle and jog trait stacks switched by an IsMoving bool with a blend smoother, checked to allocate.
entries.text: UAF 手册的入门图表：由 IsMoving 布尔值切换待机和慢跑特征栈，加混合平滑器，并检查能否分配实例。

entries.source: Build a blended idle-to-jog UAF locomotion graph
entries.text: 构建待机到慢跑混合的 UAF 移动图表

entries.source: A two-way UAF blend between a normal and an injured walk, weighted by an InjuryAmount float, with both players in one sync group.
entries.text: 在正常行走和受伤行走之间做双向 UAF 混合，由 InjuryAmount 浮点数控制权重，两个播放器同属一个同步组。

entries.source: Blend a limp into walking by injury amount in UAF
entries.text: 在 UAF 中按受伤程度把跛行混入行走

entries.source: Build Epic's Motion Matching trait stack (blend stack, smoother, motion matching, history) on an indexed Pose Search database.
entries.text: 在已建索引的 Pose Search 数据库上搭建 Epic 的运动匹配特征栈（混合栈、平滑器、运动匹配、历史收集）。

entries.source: Drive a UAF graph with a motion matching database
entries.text: 用运动匹配数据库驱动 UAF 图表

entries.source: Read an Animation Blueprint's locomotion states and rebuild them as UAF trait stacks, leaving the Blueprint untouched, then list what did not port.
entries.text: 读取动画蓝图的移动状态，用 UAF 特征栈重建，不改动原蓝图，并列出未能移植的内容。

entries.source: Port an Anim Blueprint's idle and move core to UAF
entries.text: 把动画蓝图的待机与移动核心移植到 UAF

entries.source: Direction on one axis and Speed on the other.
entries.text: 一个轴为方向，另一个轴为速度。

entries.source: Idle when still and a 2D Direction by Speed blend space when moving, switched by IsMoving with an inertializer instead of a crossfade.
entries.text: 静止时播放待机，移动时播放方向×速度的二维混合空间，由 IsMoving 切换并用惯性化代替交叉淡入淡出。

entries.source: Build a UAF strafe graph with an inertialized switch
entries.text: 构建带惯性化切换的 UAF 横移图表

entries.source: Stack = asset object path, separated by semicolons.
entries.text: 格式为“特征栈 = 资产对象路径”，用分号分隔。

entries.source: Point a UAF graph's players at new clips, such as retargeted ones, and set its blend time, then prove nothing else changed.
entries.text: 把 UAF 图表的播放器指向新动画（例如重定向后的动画）并设置混合时间，再证明其他内容未变。

entries.source: Swap a UAF graph's clips and retune its blend time
entries.text: 替换 UAF 图表的动画并重设混合时间

entries.source: Add a sync group to every player stack that feeds a blend, so blended walk and run feet stay in phase, and flag clips without sync markers.
entries.text: 为每个参与混合的播放器特征栈加入同步组，让混合后的行走和奔跑脚步保持同相，并标出缺少同步标记的动画。

entries.source: Keep a UAF graph's blended cycles in step with sync groups
entries.text: 用同步组让 UAF 图表中混合的循环动画保持同步

entries.source: Add missing screen-reader text and raise small fonts on the selected Widget Blueprint, then prove zero accessibility warnings remain.
entries.text: 为所选控件蓝图补全读屏文本并放大过小的字体，然后证明已无任何无障碍警告。

entries.source: Run an accessibility pass on a Widget Blueprint
entries.text: 对控件蓝图进行无障碍检查

entries.source: List every legacy property binding in a folder's Widget Blueprints, check binding health, and rank which screens to move to events or MVVM.
entries.text: 列出文件夹内控件蓝图中所有旧式属性绑定，检查绑定健康状况，并排出应改为事件或 MVVM 的界面优先级。

entries.source: Find per-frame property bindings across your UI
entries.text: 找出界面中每帧运行的属性绑定

entries.source: Build a top-centred boss frame with name, health bar and stagger meter that scales in over 0.4 s, validated and pictured.
entries.text: 构建顶部居中的首领框，含名字、血条和硬直条，0.4 秒内缩放入场，并完成验证和截图。

entries.source: Add a boss health bar with a stagger meter
entries.text: 添加带硬直条的首领血条

entries.source: Create a centred title menu with Play, Options and Quit, wrap-around gamepad navigation and a 0.3 s intro, then validate and picture it.
entries.text: 创建居中的标题菜单，包含开始、选项和退出按钮、可循环的手柄导航和 0.3 秒入场动画，然后验证并截图。
构建支持手柄的主菜单

entries.source: Read the selected Widget Blueprint's layout, link every focusable control in reading order with wrap at the ends, and prove each link.
entries.text: 读取所选控件蓝图的布局，按阅读顺序连接每个可聚焦控件并在两端循环，然后证明每条导航链接。

entries.source: Fix gamepad and keyboard navigation on a menu
entries.text: 修复菜单的手柄和键盘导航

entries.source: Build a small key-cap and action prompt anchored above the bottom centre, with a 0.15 s fade-in, validated and pictured.
entries.text: 构建一个小巧的按键图标加动作提示，锚定在底部中央上方，带 0.15 秒淡入，并完成验证和截图。

entries.source: Make a 'press key to interact' prompt
Make one slot widget, then fill a uniform grid with rows x columns copies of it across plans of up to 64 ops, and prove every cell.
entries.text: 先制作一个格子控件，再分多次（每次最多 64 个操作）把它按行 × 列填满统一网格，并证明每个单元格。

entries.source: Build an RPG inventory grid from a reusable slot
entries.text: 用可复用格子构建 RPG 背包网格

entries.source: Blueprint that shows it for the test
0 to 100; about 85 for an aligned match.
Rebuild a screen from a mockup, capture it in play and score it with image compare, changing one thing per round until it reaches the target.
entries.text: 依据设计稿重建界面，在游戏中截图并用图像比较打分，每轮只改一处，直到达到目标分数。

entries.source: Match a UI mockup image and score it
entries.text: 按 UI 设计稿还原并评分

entries.source: Create a view model with name, health and level fields, bind them to a new stats panel with MVVM, and prove every binding and compile.
entries.text: 创建含名字、生命值和等级字段的视图模型，用 MVVM 绑定到新的属性面板，并证明每个绑定和编译结果。

entries.source: Drive a stats panel from an MVVM view model
entries.text: 用 MVVM 视图模型驱动属性面板

entries.text: 它可以读取文件并调用 Unreal 工具，但不能写入文件或运行命令。

entries.source: Each subagent is defined once in .hyperai/agents and written out for Claude Code (.claude/agents) and Codex (.codex/agents). A chat hands work to one by name, or the whole team takes a request: the Team switch in the chat, /hyperai-team in Claude Code, $team in Codex.
entries.text: 每个子智能体在 .hyperai/agents 中定义一次，并为 Claude Code（.claude/agents）和 Codex（.codex/agents）写出。对话可以按名称把工作交给其中一个，也可以让整个团队接下请求：对话中的“团队”开关，Claude Code 中的 /hyperai-team，Codex 中的 $team。

entries.text: 将所有保留的文件写入项目，并先保存智能体未保存的内容。之后保存的内容由新的沙盒保留。

entries.text: 让智能体的请求在一段时间内无需询问你即可运行。开启前会说明它覆盖的范围并请你确认。

entries.text: 结束后台会话。对话内容会保留，可以稍后继续。

entries.text: 此对话调用了 Unreal MCP 工具。

entries.source: Codex, Claude Code or Gemini, working in this editor.
entries.text: Codex、Claude Code 或 Gemini，在这个编辑器中工作。

entries.source: Agents, tools and tests for this project, in one place.
entries.text: 本项目的智能体、工具和测试，集中在一处。

entries.source: Concept art and references, with Nano Banana or Codex.
entries.text: 概念图和参考图，使用 Nano Banana 或 Codex。

entries.source: Compare the level with a target image, side by side.
entries.text: 将关卡与目标图像并排比较。

entries.source: What agents should know about this project.
entries.text: 智能体应了解的关于本项目的信息。

entries.source: A bot plays like a person, many cases at once.
entries.text: 机器人像真人一样玩，多个用例同时进行。

entries.source: Unreal MCP and the agent files are not ready yet, so agents cannot work in this editor.
entries.text: Unreal MCP 和智能体文件尚未就绪，因此智能体还无法在这个编辑器中工作。

entries.source: Any HyperAI or Unreal tool, as a form.
entries.text: 任意 HyperAI 或 Unreal 工具，以表单形式运行。

entries.source: Letters, digits and underscore: it names the folder the images land in.
entries.text: 字母、数字和下划线：它就是图片存放文件夹的名称。

entries.source: Copy its project-relative path, to paste into a chat.
entries.text: 复制它在项目中的相对路径，以便粘贴到聊天中。

entries.source: Generate takes the picture through HyperAI_MatchCamera, placing that camera where the level viewport looks if the level has none, and the model changes only its light. Move the camera to relight another view.
entries.text: 生成时会通过 HyperAI_MatchCamera 截取画面；关卡中没有这台相机时，会把它放在关卡视口所看的位置。模型只改变画面的光照。移动这台相机即可为其他视角重新布光。

entries.source: Generate the batch. This spends money, or your agent's plan for an agent model; pressing it is the approval.
entries.text: 生成这一批图片。这会花钱，若使用智能体模型则消耗你的智能体套餐；按下它即表示批准。

entries.source: Your preferred agent builds the level toward this picture as a level designer would, then lights it, until it matches. Follow it on the Match page.
entries.text: 你偏好的智能体会像关卡设计师一样朝这张图搭建关卡，再为它布光，直到匹配为止。可在匹配页面跟进。

entries.source: Your preferred agent relights the level until it matches this picture, and HyperAI sends it back to work after each round until it does. Follow it on the Match page.
entries.text: 你偏好的智能体会重新为关卡布光，直到与这张图匹配；每轮结束后 HyperAI 都会让它继续，直到达成。可在匹配页面跟进。

entries.source: Then match the level's lighting to it
entries.text: 然后把关卡的光照匹配到这张图

entries.source: When the picture arrives, your preferred agent relights the level until it matches, as Match the lighting to this does. With more than one image, pick one and use Match the lighting to this.
entries.text: 图片生成后，你的首选智能体会为关卡重新布光直到匹配，与“按这张图匹配光照”相同。生成多张时，请选中一张再使用“按这张图匹配光照”。

entries.source: What to keep out, such as text or people.
entries.text: 不希望出现的内容，例如文字或人物。

entries.source: This model draws from words only, so it cannot relight a view. Pick a Nano Banana model or Codex.
entries.text: 这个模型只能根据文字作画，无法为视角重新布光。请选择 Nano Banana 模型或 Codex。

entries.source: None: send the prompt as written
Reference images for the look you are after: pick a preset, say what it is of, and Generate. From Nano Banana, Codex or a model you configure, written into the project with the prompt that made them.
entries.text: 为你想要的效果生成参考图像：选一个预设，说明画的是什么，然后点“生成”。可用 Nano Banana、Codex 或你配置的模型，图像连同生成它的提示词一起写入项目。

entries.source: Who they are: their silhouette, clothing, gear and colours. For example: a desert scout in layered cloth with a brass spyglass.
entries.text: 这是谁：轮廓、服装、装备和配色。例如：身披层叠布衣、手持黄铜望远镜的沙漠斥候。

entries.source: The mark: cracks, stains, scorch marks, footprints, graffiti. For example: a scorch mark with soot spray.
entries.text: 痕迹本身：裂纹、污渍、焦痕、脚印、涂鸦。例如：带有烟灰飞溅的焦痕。

entries.source: The icon's subject and style. For example: a glowing fire rune on a stone disc.
entries.text: 图标的主体和风格。例如：石盘上发光的火焰符文。

entries.source: The level as a player sees it: the layout, the landmarks, the paths, the scale. For example: a ruined courtyard with a broken bridge over a gorge.
entries.text: 玩家眼中的关卡：布局、地标、路径和尺度。例如：峡谷上方有断桥的废弃庭院。

entries.source: Preset name, such as Ember concept
entries.text: 预设名称，例如 余烬概念

entries.source: The prompt you have written becomes the preset's style, kept with the preset's own words, the shape, the count and what to keep out. Presets live in .hyperai/image-presets.json, shared with the team.
entries.text: 你写的提示词会成为该预设的风格，与预设自带的描述、画幅、张数和排除项一起保存。预设保存在 .hyperai/image-presets.json，与团队共享。

entries.source: The object: what it is, its material, size and style. For example: an iron lantern with cracked green glass.
entries.text: 物体本身：是什么、材质、大小和风格。例如：玻璃碎裂泛绿的铁灯笼。

entries.source: How the view should be lit: the time of day, where the light comes from, its colour, the weather and the mood. For example: late dusk, warm lamps glowing inside, cool blue moonlight through the windows, a little fog.
entries.text: 这个视角应该如何照明：一天中的时刻、光从哪里来、光的颜色、天气和氛围。例如：深黄昏，室内暖色灯光亮起，冷蓝色月光透过窗户，些许薄雾。

entries.source: A place at a time of day: where it is, when, the weather, the mood. For example: a mountain monastery at dusk, low sun, thin fog.
entries.text: 某个时刻的某个地方：在哪里、何时、天气和氛围。例如：黄昏时分的山间寺院，低垂的太阳，薄雾。

entries.source: The sky: the time of day, the clouds, the colour. For example: a stormy sunset, towering clouds lit orange from below.
entries.text: 天空：时间、云层和色彩。例如：暴风雨中的日落，高耸的云层被自下而上染成橙色。

entries.source: The surface: its material, age, wear and colour. For example: mossy cobblestones, wet after rain.
entries.text: 表面：材质、年代、磨损和颜色。例如：雨后湿润、长满青苔的鹅卵石。

entries.source: A free dry run: the exact prompt that would be sent, and what it costs.
entries.text: 免费试运行：将要发送的确切提示词及其花费。

entries.source: What to draw, as you would tell an artist.
entries.text: 要画什么，像对画师说的那样描述。

entries.source: Put its prompt, model and seed back in the form.
entries.text: 把它的提示词、模型和种子填回表单。

entries.source: Save these settings as a preset for the team
entries.text: 把这些设置保存为团队预设

entries.source: -1 for a random seed. A fixed seed re-renders the same image, where the model takes one.
entries.text: -1 表示随机种子。固定种子会重新渲染同一张图片（需模型支持种子）。

entries.source: Open the folder it is in.
Open the Match page with it: the level's lighting measured against it, and any match session's attempts.
entries.text: 用它打开匹配页面：关卡光照与它的对比，以及任意匹配会话的尝试。

entries.source: What it is of; the preset {0} adds its style.
entries.text: 画的是什么；预设 {0} 会加上它的风格。

entries.source: Agent edits are marked dirty in Lore once saved; hyper_source_control_submit commits them here after you approve.
entries.text: 智能体的改动保存后会在 Lore 中标记为已修改；经你批准后，hyper_source_control_submit 会在本机提交它们。

entries.source: Until it is set up, agent edits are saved as they are, with no version control.
entries.text: 在设置好之前，智能体的改动会直接保存，不受版本控制。

entries.source: Agent edits lock each file on the server first (a teammate's lock turns the edit away); hyper_source_control_submit commits and pushes after you approve.
entries.text: 智能体编辑前会先在服务器上锁定每个文件（队友持有锁时编辑会被拒绝）；经你批准后，hyper_source_control_submit 会提交并推送。

entries.source: The lore command is needed to check a server.
entries.text: 检查服务器需要 lore 命令。

entries.source: Asks the server for its repositories (lore repository list). Changes nothing.
entries.text: 向服务器查询其仓库列表（lore repository list）。不做任何更改。

entries.source: The lore command was not found. {0} Install it with Epic's installer (PowerShell: irm https://raw.githubusercontent.com/EpicGames/lore/main/scripts/install.ps1 | iex), then press Refresh.
entries.text: 未找到 lore 命令。{0} 请用 Epic 的安装程序安装（PowerShell：irm https://raw.githubusercontent.com/EpicGames/lore/main/scripts/install.ps1 | iex），然后点击“刷新”。

entries.source: Lore is pre-1.0 and changes quickly. HyperAI uses only its command line, and never signs in or reads its tokens.
entries.text: Lore 尚未到 1.0，变化很快。HyperAI 只使用它的命令行，从不登录，也从不读取它的令牌。

entries.source: Found {0}, but lore --version did not report a version (exit code {1}): {2}
entries.text: 找到了 {0}，但 lore --version 没有报告版本（退出码 {1}）：{2}

entries.source: HyperAI looks for lore on PATH and in %USERPROFILE%\bin.
entries.text: HyperAI 会在 PATH 和 %USERPROFILE%\bin 中查找 lore。

entries.source: Empty: found on PATH or in %USERPROFILE%\bin. Otherwise the full path of lore.exe.
entries.text: 留空：在 PATH 或 %USERPROFILE%\bin 中查找。否则填写 lore.exe 的完整路径。
