entries.source: Also keep out what the project's .gitignore ignores (Lore does not read .gitignore)
entries.text: 同时排除项目 .gitignore 所忽略的内容（Lore 不读取 .gitignore）

entries.source: Copies the rules of .gitignore that .loreignore lacks, under a heading of their own after the Unreal ones. Off: files only .gitignore keeps out, such as per-user settings, are committed.
entries.text: 把 .loreignore 缺少的 .gitignore 规则复制进来，放在 Unreal 规则之后的单独标题下。关闭时：只有 .gitignore 排除的文件（例如个人设置）会被提交。

entries.source: Copy the command, to paste in a terminal.
entries.text: 复制该命令，以便粘贴到终端中。

entries.source: Reads the server's list of repositories. Changes nothing. Undo: nothing to undo.
entries.text: 读取服务器的仓库列表。不做任何更改。撤销：无需撤销。

entries.source: Records the first revision. Works without a network. Undo: the revision stays in the history; deleting .lore starts over.
entries.text: 记录第一个修订版本。无需网络。撤销：该修订会留在历史中；删除 .lore 即可重新开始。

entries.source: Adds a .lore folder to {0}, where Lore keeps the history on this computer. No server is used; your files are not changed. Undo: delete the .lore folder; the repository and its history go, your files stay.
entries.text: 在 {0} 中添加一个 .lore 文件夹，Lore 会把历史保存在这台电脑上。不使用服务器；你的文件不会被更改。撤销：删除 .lore 文件夹；仓库及其历史会被删除，你的文件保留。

entries.source: Registers the repository on the server and adds a .lore folder to {0}. Your files are not changed. Undo: delete the .lore folder, and run lore repository delete {1} to remove it from the server.
entries.text: 在服务器上注册该仓库，并在 {0} 中添加一个 .lore 文件夹。你的文件不会被更改。撤销：删除 .lore 文件夹，并运行 lore repository delete {1} 将其从服务器上移除。

entries.source: Appends lines, so Binaries, Intermediate, Saved, DerivedDataCache, plugin builds, IDE files, *.sln and HyperAI's per-machine .hyperai/runtime folder stay out of the repository. Undo: remove the lines under the HyperAI Studio headings.
entries.text: 追加若干行，使 Binaries、Intermediate、Saved、DerivedDataCache、插件构建、IDE 文件、*.sln 以及 HyperAI 的本机 .hyperai/runtime 文件夹不进入仓库。撤销：删除 HyperAI Studio 标题下的那些行。

entries.source: {0} Lore does not read .gitignore, so the project's .gitignore rules that .loreignore lacks ({1}) are copied in too.
entries.text: {0} Lore 不读取 .gitignore，因此项目 .gitignore 中 .loreignore 缺少的规则（{1} 条）也会被复制进来。

entries.source: {0} Lore does not read .gitignore: whatever only the project's .gitignore keeps out will be committed.
entries.text: {0} Lore 不读取 .gitignore：只由项目 .gitignore 排除的内容将会被提交。

entries.source: Writes the file, so Binaries, Intermediate, Saved, DerivedDataCache, plugin builds, IDE files, *.sln and HyperAI's per-machine .hyperai/runtime folder stay out of the repository. Undo: delete .loreignore.
entries.text: 写入该文件，使 Binaries、Intermediate、Saved、DerivedDataCache、插件构建、IDE 文件、*.sln 以及 HyperAI 的本机 .hyperai/runtime 文件夹不进入仓库。撤销：删除 .loreignore。

entries.source: Uploads the project's files to the server, where the team can clone them. Undo: lore repository delete {0} removes it from the server.
entries.text: 把项目文件上传到服务器，团队可以从那里克隆。撤销：lore repository delete {0} 会将其从服务器上移除。

entries.source: Walks the folder and stages what .loreignore leaves in; a large project takes a while. Undo: lore unstage .
entries.text: 遍历文件夹，暂存 .loreignore 未排除的内容；大型项目需要一些时间。撤销：lore unstage .

entries.source: Commit the project as the first revision
entries.text: 将项目提交为第一个修订版本

entries.source: Stages every file the ignore rules leave in and commits it (and pushes it, on a server).
entries.text: 暂存忽略规则未排除的所有文件并提交（使用服务器时还会推送）。

entries.source: Open Epic's guide to installing the lore command.
entries.text: 打开 Epic 的 lore 命令安装指南。

entries.source: To work on a project a teammate already put on a server: lore clone <server>/<name> <folder>, then open its .uproject.
entries.text: 要参与队友已放到服务器上的项目：运行 lore clone <server>/<name> <folder>，然后打开其中的 .uproject。

entries.source: Optional: recorded on commits in a repository set up here
entries.text: 可选：记录在此处设置的仓库的提交中

entries.source: Open lore.org, Epic's page for Lore.
entries.text: 打开 lore.org，Epic 的 Lore 页面。

entries.source: Empty: local only. lore://127.0.0.1:41337 for a loreserver on this computer.
entries.text: 留空：仅本机。本机上的 loreserver 用 lore://127.0.0.1:41337。

entries.source: Local: the history stays in this computer's .lore folder; no server, no locks.
entries.text: 本地：历史保存在这台电脑的 .lore 文件夹中；没有服务器，没有锁。

entries.source: Not set up: this project is in no Lore workspace.
entries.text: 未设置：此项目不在任何 Lore 工作区中。

entries.source: Server: pushes to {0}, and agents lock files there before editing them.
entries.text: 服务器：推送到 {0}，智能体编辑文件前会先在那里锁定。

entries.source: Unknown: .lore/config.toml could not be read, so HyperAI treats it as a server repository: agents lock files before editing them, and a submit pushes.
entries.text: 未知：无法读取 .lore/config.toml，因此 HyperAI 将其视为服务器仓库：智能体编辑文件前会先加锁，提交时会推送。

entries.source: This repository is local. Lore 0.10 sets the server when a repository is made, so moving to a server later means a new repository there (set it up from a copy of the project, or ask the server's owner to import it); this local history stays here.
entries.text: 此仓库是本地仓库。Lore 0.10 在创建仓库时确定服务器，因此以后迁移到服务器意味着在那里新建一个仓库（从项目副本进行设置，或请服务器管理员导入）；这里的本地历史会保留在本机。

entries.source: Install the lore command first (Install guide, above), then press Refresh.
entries.text: 请先安装 lore 命令（见上方“安装指南”），然后点击“刷新”。

entries.source: Enter the server's address, such as lore://127.0.0.1:41337, or keep the repository on this computer.
entries.text: 请输入服务器地址，例如 lore://127.0.0.1:41337，或者把仓库保留在这台电脑上。

entries.source: No server is set: enter one in Lore Server and press Save.
entries.text: 未设置服务器：请在“Lore 服务器”中填写并点击“保存”。

entries.source: For when a server is available: a loreserver you host (lore://host:41337), or Epic's hosted Lore once it opens. These settings are kept per user and project, never in the project's files.
entries.text: 适用于有服务器可用时：你自己托管的 loreserver（lore://host:41337），或 Epic 托管的 Lore（开放后）。这些设置按用户和项目保存，从不写入项目文件。
{0} 已经是 Lore 工作区。

entries.source: The identity is a name or email: no quotes or control characters, and not starting with '-'.
entries.text: 身份是名字或电子邮件：不能包含引号或控制字符，也不能以“-”开头。

entries.source: "{0}" is not a repository name Lore accepts: letters, digits, '/', '-', '_' and '.', up to 100.
entries.text: “{0}”不是 Lore 接受的仓库名：只能包含字母、数字、“/”、“-”、“_”和“.”，最多 100 个字符。

entries.source: The lore command set below names a file that does not exist.
entries.text: 下方设置的 lore 命令指向的文件不存在。

entries.source: The lore command set below is not a file named lore.exe, so HyperAI does not run it.
entries.text: 下方设置的 lore 命令不是名为 lore.exe 的文件，因此 HyperAI 不会运行它。

entries.source: The lore command is not on PATH, nor in %USERPROFILE%\bin where Lore's installer puts it.
entries.text: lore 命令不在 PATH 中，也不在 Lore 安装程序放置它的 %USERPROFILE%\bin 中。

entries.source: {0} is inside the Lore workspace {1} already; set up the workspace's own folder, or none.
entries.text: {0} 已位于 Lore 工作区 {1} 之内；请设置该工作区本身的文件夹，或者不设置。

entries.source: A server address names its host, and carries no user name or password.
entries.text: 服务器地址需要写明主机，且不能包含用户名或密码。

entries.source: The server address does not start with a URL scheme, such as lore://.
entries.text: 服务器地址没有以 URL 协议（例如 lore://）开头。

entries.source: A Lore server is an address such as lore://127.0.0.1:41337 (scheme, host, and port when it is not the default).
entries.text: Lore 服务器地址的格式类似 lore://127.0.0.1:41337（协议、主机，以及非默认时的端口）。

entries.source: A server address has no spaces or quotes.
entries.text: 服务器地址不能包含空格或引号。

entries.source: Unreal's {0} provider is set up, so agent edits check out through it rather than through Lore.
entries.text: 已设置 Unreal 的 {0} 提供程序，因此智能体的编辑通过它签出，而不是通过 Lore。

entries.source: Look for the lore command, the workspace and sign-ins again.
entries.text: 重新查找 lore 命令、工作区和登录信息。

entries.source: Keep the server and identity for this project (Preferences has them too).
entries.text: 为此项目保存服务器和身份（“偏好设置”中也有这些设置）。

entries.source: Shows the steps once more and runs them after you confirm.
entries.text: 再次列出这些步骤，并在你确认后运行。

entries.source: Done: {0} is now a Lore workspace. {1} Agent edits go through Lore from now on; hyper_source_control_status shows it.
entries.text: 完成：{0} 现在是一个 Lore 工作区。{1} 从现在起，智能体的编辑通过 Lore 进行；hyper_source_control_status 会显示这一点。

entries.source: A step failed (its output is above) and no repository was made. Fix what it says and set up again; a .loreignore written so far can stay.
entries.text: 有一步失败了（输出见上方），没有创建仓库。按提示修正后重新设置；已写入的 .loreignore 可以保留。

entries.source: A step failed (its output is above) after the repository was made. Finish by hand with the commands shown, or delete the .lore folder to start over.
entries.text: 仓库创建后有一步失败了（输出见上方）。可以用上面显示的命令手动完成，或删除 .lore 文件夹重新开始。

entries.source: Makes this folder a Lore workspace. A local repository needs no server and suits working alone; a server repository can be shared, pushed and locked. Lore sets the server when the repository is made.
entries.text: 把此文件夹变成 Lore 工作区。本地仓库不需要服务器，适合独自工作；服务器仓库可以共享、推送和加锁。Lore 在创建仓库时确定服务器。

entries.source: Set up Lore for this project

A server with sign-in turned on (Epic's hosted Lore signs in with an Epic account) needs you to sign in once, yourself, in a terminal: run the command below. It opens the sign-in page in your browser. HyperAI only shows the command; it never signs in, and never reads or keeps tokens.
entries.text: 启用了登录的服务器（Epic 托管的 Lore 使用 Epic 账户登录）需要你亲自在终端中登录一次：运行下面的命令，它会在浏览器中打开登录页面。HyperAI 只显示该命令；它从不登录，也从不读取或保存令牌。

entries.source: A local repository needs no sign-in.
The lore command is signed in as: {0}
Check that the Lore server {0} answers
entries.text: 检查 Lore 服务器 {0} 是否响应

entries.source: Create the local repository {0} in this folder
entries.text: 在此文件夹中创建本地仓库 {0}

entries.source: Create the repository {0} on {1}, with this folder as its workspace
entries.text: 在 {1} 上创建仓库 {0}，并以此文件夹作为其工作区

entries.source: Add Unreal's build output and caches to .loreignore
entries.text: 把 Unreal 的构建输出和缓存加入 .loreignore

entries.source: Write .loreignore for Unreal's build output and caches
entries.text: 为 Unreal 的构建输出和缓存写入 .loreignore
把第一个修订版本推送到 {0}

entries.source: Stage every project file that is not ignored
entries.text: 暂存所有未被忽略的项目文件

entries.source: Epic's Lore (lore.org) for this project: a local repository now, a server when you have one. Nothing here runs until you confirm it.
entries.text: 为此项目使用 Epic 的 Lore（lore.org）：现在用本地仓库，有服务器时再用服务器。你确认之前这里不会运行任何操作。

entries.source: Keep this path for this project. Only a file named lore.exe is accepted, and only here: agents' settings tools cannot choose which program HyperAI runs.
entries.text: 为此项目保存这个路径。只接受名为 lore.exe 的文件，并且只能在这里设置：智能体的设置工具无法选择 HyperAI 运行哪个程序。

entries.source: Make it on a Lore server instead of this computer only
entries.text: 在 Lore 服务器上创建，而不是只在这台电脑上

entries.source: On: lore repository create <server>/<name>. Off: lore repository create --offline <name>, kept in this folder's .lore.
entries.text: 开启：lore repository create <server>/<name>。关闭：lore repository create --offline <name>，保存在此文件夹的 .lore 中。

entries.source: Keep Unreal's build output and caches out (.loreignore)
entries.text: 排除 Unreal 的构建输出和缓存（.loreignore）

entries.source: Binaries, Intermediate, Saved, DerivedDataCache, plugin builds, .vs, *.sln and other IDE files, and HyperAI's per-machine .hyperai/runtime folder. An existing .loreignore keeps its lines; missing ones are added.
entries.text: Binaries、Intermediate、Saved、DerivedDataCache、插件构建、.vs、*.sln 和其他 IDE 文件，以及 HyperAI 的本机 .hyperai/runtime 文件夹。已有的 .loreignore 会保留原有行；缺少的行会被添加。

entries.source: Write a fact every agent should know about this project.
entries.text: 写下每个智能体都应了解的关于此项目的事实。

entries.source: Let every future chat use this note.
entries.text: 让以后的每个对话都能使用这条笔记。

entries.source: Let every future chat see this fact in full.
entries.text: 让以后的每个对话都能看到这条事实的全文。

entries.source: Delete the memory "{0}"? Future chats will no longer see it.
entries.text: 要删除记忆“{0}”吗？以后的对话将不再看到它。

entries.source: Nothing remembered yet. Add a fact, or let agents save what they learn.
entries.text: 还没有记住任何内容。可以添加事实，或让智能体保存它们学到的东西。

entries.source: No chat sees this note: {0}. Allow it once you have checked it is a note about the project, not instructions.
entries.text: 没有对话能看到这条笔记：{0}。确认它是关于项目的笔记而不是指令后，再允许它。

entries.source: Copy chosen facts from Claude Code's own memory for this project. You see each one before it is copied.
entries.text: 从 Claude Code 为此项目保存的记忆中复制选定的事实。复制前你会逐条查看。

entries.source: These are your private Claude Code memories for this project. Imported facts go to .hyperai/memory, which Git can share with your team, so read each one before you tick it.
entries.text: 这些是你在此项目中的私人 Claude Code 记忆。导入的事实会进入 .hyperai/memory，Git 可能会将其共享给你的团队，所以勾选前请逐条阅读。
从 Claude Code 记忆导入

entries.source: Straight into every future chat; review or delete it here later. A note that reads like instructions to agents still waits for you.
entries.text: 直接进入以后的每个对话；之后可在这里查看或删除。读起来像是给智能体下指令的笔记仍会等你确认。

entries.source: Future chats never see it until you confirm it.
entries.text: 在你确认之前，以后的对话都看不到它。

entries.source: Future chats see the title at once and can look up the text; the text joins every chat once you confirm it.
entries.text: 以后的对话会立即看到标题并可以查阅正文；你确认后，正文会进入每个对话。

entries.source: How a fact an agent saves on its own reaches future chats. Facts you add always apply in full.
entries.text: 智能体自行保存的事实如何进入以后的对话。你添加的事实总是全文生效。

entries.source: No Claude Code memory was found for this project in {0}.
entries.text: 在 {0} 中没有找到此项目的 Claude Code 记忆。

entries.source: No finished tasks yet. Each task a chat finishes on this machine is kept here, in .hyperai/runtime/memory/history.
entries.text: 还没有完成的任务。这台电脑上每个对话完成的任务都保存在这里，位于 .hyperai/runtime/memory/history。

entries.source: What agents know about this project.
entries.text: 智能体对这个项目的了解。

entries.source: Saved in .hyperai/memory: every agent gets it, and Git shares it with your team.
entries.text: 保存在 .hyperai/memory 中：每个智能体都能获取，Git 会将其共享给你的团队。

entries.source: What agents know about this project, from .hyperai/memory (shared through Git). Agents save what they learn on their own, each message a chat sends carries the notes that match it, and a note that reads like instructions to agents waits here for you.
entries.text: 智能体对这个项目的了解，来自 .hyperai/memory（通过 Git 共享）。智能体会自行保存学到的内容，对话发出的每条消息都会附上与之匹配的笔记，而读起来像是给智能体下指令的笔记会在这里等你确认。

entries.source: Every task a chat finished on this machine: what was asked and how it ended. Agents find these when a new task looks like an old one.
entries.text: 这台电脑上对话完成的每个任务：提出了什么要求，结果如何。新任务与旧任务相似时，智能体会找到它们。

entries.source: What every future chat should know, and why.
entries.text: 以后的每个对话都应知道什么，以及原因。

entries.source: One line: what this is about
entries.text: 一行：这条事实是关于什么的

entries.source: Attach a picture for the agent to look at. Dropping image files onto the chat does the same.
entries.text: 附加一张图片供智能体查看。将图片文件拖到聊天中也可以。

entries.source: Attach what the level viewport shows now.
entries.text: 附加关卡视口当前显示的画面。

entries.source: Message {0}. Enter sends; Shift+Enter starts a new line.
entries.text: 给 {0} 发消息。Enter 发送；Shift+Enter 换行。

entries.source: Show it in the Match page, beside what the level looks like.
entries.text: 在匹配页面中显示它，与关卡当前的样子并排比较。

entries.source: Fill in: {0}. Send again to send it as it is.
entries.text: 请填写：{0}。再次发送即按原样发出。

entries.source: Team is on: this prompt is for HyperAI's team. Turn it off to send it to this agent alone.
entries.text: 团队已开启：这条提示词是给 HyperAI 团队的。关闭它即可只发给这个智能体。

entries.source: Start from a tested prompt for any kind of work; it fills in what you have selected. Ctrl+Space opens it too.
entries.text: 从经过测试的提示词开始任何工作；它会填入你当前选中的内容。也可以按 Ctrl+Space 打开。

entries.source: Copy it into the project's generated images, where the Images tab and the image tools find it.
entries.text: 复制到项目的生成图片文件夹中，图片标签页和图片工具会在那里找到它。

entries.source: Send now, or after the running turn.
entries.text: 立即发送，或在当前回合结束后发送。

entries.source: Open the folder the picture is in.
entries.text: 打开图片所在的文件夹。

entries.source: Stop the agent's current turn and drop queued messages.
entries.text: 停止智能体的当前回合，并丢弃排队的消息。

entries.source: Send your messages to HyperAI's team, not to this agent alone. The director plans the work, the programmer, level designer, lighting artist, technical artist and UI designer build their parts at once, the QA tester proves each part, and the director reviews it all against the team's quality bar. The first time, this adds the team to the project.
entries.text: 把你的消息交给 HyperAI 的团队，而不只是这个智能体。导演规划工作，程序员、关卡设计师、灯光师、技术美术和 UI 设计师同时完成各自的部分，QA 测试员验证每个部分，导演再按团队的质量标准审查全部成果。第一次使用时，会把团队添加到项目中。

entries.text: 在这台机器和这个关卡上，一次最多运行 {0} 个用例。{1}

entries.text: 正在测量这台机器一次能同时运行多少个用例……

entries.text: 该 JSON 不是 hyper_verify_run 请求，因此保持为 JSON：{0}

entries.text: hyper_verify_run 的请求：一个截止时间和由机器人步骤组成的用例。

entries.source: Pick up every actor of a kind, nearest first.
entries.text: 拾取某一类的全部 Actor，从最近的开始。

entries.text: 找到、瞄准并攻击某一类的全部 Actor，直到每一个都被击败。

entries.text: 第二名玩家加入，两名玩家相互对战。

entries.source: Results show here: each case, what every step saw, and the maps and pictures they made.
entries.text: 结果显示在这里：每个用例、每一步看到的情况，以及它们生成的地图和图片。

entries.text: 朝尚未去过的地方漫游；报告覆盖范围、卡住的位置和坠落。

entries.source: The HyperAI bot plays the open level the way a person would, through the game's own controls. Every case plays in its own copy of the level, all at the same time, and answers within a minute. Nothing in the level changes.
entries.text: HyperAI 机器人像真人一样试玩当前关卡，使用游戏自己的操作。每个用例在各自的关卡副本中运行，全部同时进行，一分钟内给出结果。关卡中的任何内容都不会改变。

entries.source: Up to {0} cases at once on this machine and level.
entries.text: 在这台机器和这个关卡上，一次最多运行 {0} 个用例。

entries.source: Play every case at once, each in its own copy of the open level, as hyper_verify_run does.
entries.text: 同时运行所有用例，每个用例在当前关卡的各自副本中进行，与 hyper_verify_run 相同。

entries.source: Walk to a place, round what is in the way and over what can be jumped.
entries.text: 走到某个位置，绕过挡路的东西，跳过能跳过的障碍。

entries.source: Auto: Claude Code and Codex approve their own routine commands and tool calls instead of asking you at every step.
